column2: Physical memory is not enough, so the system keeps shuffling data between memory and disk; this is one of the most common causes of a sudden slowdown.

column2: Data from an earlier memory squeeze is still in swap and may not be slowing things down now. Restart to clear it, or watch again the next time memory runs short.

Pomelo 防火牆管理員 — iptables 的圖形管理介面（不取代 iptables、ufw、firewalld，就地讀取、就地寫回）

用法：pomelo-firewall [選項]      沒有選項時開啟視窗

查看
  --status                  防火牆狀態（各鏈政策、規則數、命中、防護、並存的防火牆）
  --list [--json]           列出所有規則：白話說明與等價的 iptables 指令
  --bans                    封鎖清單（Pomelo 防護的 ipset）
  --backups                 備份清單

修改（需要管理員；寫回前自動備份、預檢、%d 秒內沒有 --confirm 就自動還原）
  --allow 埠[/協定] [--from CIDR]    允許連入（預設 tcp）。例：--allow 80、--allow 53/udp --from 192.168.1.0/24
  --deny 埠[/協定]|IP|CIDR           拒絕：埠（丟棄該埠的連入）或 IP（丟棄來自該 IP 的封包）
  --remove 鏈:編號 [--table 表] [--ipv6]   刪除規則（預設 filter 表、IPv4；編號見 --list）
  --basic [basic|desktop|web|strict]   套用基本規則範本（預設 basic；INPUT 預設政策改為拒絕，並保留你目前連線的來源）
  --timeout 秒              自訂自動還原秒數（0＝不設，預設 30）；--yes 略過互動確認；--i-understand 接受預檢警告
  --confirm                 保留剛才的變更（取消自動還原）

Pomelo Firewall Manager — a graphical manager for iptables (does not replace iptables, ufw or firewalld; reads and writes rules in place)

Usage: pomelo-firewall [options]      Opens the window when no options are given

View
  --status                  Firewall status (chain policies, rule counts, hits, protection, coexisting firewalls)
  --list [--json]           List all rules: plain-language description and the equivalent iptables command
  --bans                    Ban list (Pomelo Protection ipset)
  --backups                 Backup list

Modify (needs administrator; backs up and pre-checks before writing, and auto-reverts if there is no --confirm within %d seconds)
  --allow port[/proto] [--from CIDR]    Allow inbound (tcp by default). Examples: --allow 80, --allow 53/udp --from 192.168.1.0/24
  --deny port[/proto]|IP|CIDR           Deny: a port (drop inbound to that port) or an IP (drop packets from that IP)
  --remove chain:number [--table table] [--ipv6]   Delete a rule (filter table, IPv4 by default; numbers are shown by --list)
  --basic [basic|desktop|web|strict]   Apply a basic rule template (basic by default; INPUT default policy becomes reject, and your current connection source is kept)
  --timeout seconds         Custom auto-revert seconds (0 = none, default 30); --yes skips interactive confirmation; --i-understand accepts pre-check warnings
  --confirm                 Keep the changes just made (cancel the auto-revert)
  --revert                  Revert immediately to the backup taken before the write

Protection (POMELO_* chains and ipsets; manages only its own chains)
  --protect level           loose|standard|strict|off (SYN flood, connection limits, invalid packets, anti-spoofing, auto-ban)
  --ban IP [--for time]     Ban an IP (time examples: 10m, 1h, 2d, perm; default 1h)
  --unban IP                Remove a ban

Backup, import and export
  --backup [reason]         Create a backup (full iptables-save output)
  --restore name            Restore a backup
  --export file             Export Pomelo JSON (with plain-language descriptions)
  --export-iptables file    Export in iptables-save format (IPv4; IPv6 follows "# ip6tables")
  --import file|--import-iptables file   Import (validates format and size limit, shows the diff, backs up before importing; unrecognized rules are rejected rather than written blindly)

Emergency recovery (if you lock yourself out, run on a local terminal or in rescue mode)
  pomelo-firewall --reset   Remove only Pomelo's own protection chains and ipsets; other system rules are untouched
  pomelo-firewall --disable Same as above, and also cancel "restore at boot"
  pomelo-firewall --restore name   or use iptables-restore < /var/lib/pomelo-firewall/backups/name.v4 directly

column1:
與 ufw、firewalld、Docker 並存：
• 它們在 nftables 之上運作，iptables-nft 的規則和它們一起評估——任何一邊丟棄，封包就被丟棄。
• 它們管理的鏈（ufw-*、DOCKER*、KUBE-*、f2b-* 等）在這裡標示「由某某管理」，預設唯讀；直接改，下次它們重新載入就會被覆蓋。ufw 請用 ufw allow，firewalld 請用 firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=…。
• DOCKER-USER 是 Docker 官方建議放使用者規則的地方，可以編輯。
• Pomelo 不會停用任何一個。
column2:
Coexisting with ufw, firewalld and Docker:
• They run on top of nftables, and iptables-nft rules are evaluated together with theirs: if either side drops a packet, it is dropped.
• Chains they manage (ufw-*, DOCKER*, KUBE-*, f2b-*, etc.) are labeled "managed by ..." here and are read-only by default; direct edits are overwritten the next time they reload. For ufw use ufw allow; for firewalld use firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=...
• DOCKER-USER is where Docker officially recommends putting user rules, and it can be edited.
• Pomelo does not disable any of them.

  2. 這個包裡「沒有」密碼雜湊（不讀 /etc/shadow）、沒有私鑰、沒有 authorized_keys 的內容（只有指紋）、沒有檔案本體（只有雜湊與屬性）；文字中的 password=、token= 之類也已遮蔽。
  3. 這些是在本機上收集的；被攻陷的核心（例如核心層的 rootkit）可以讓看到的內容不真實。若要認真鑑識，請用外部乾淨環境（開機光碟）重新取證。

This is a snapshot of the machine's state, saved when you suspect an intrusion. It only reads and stores text and hashes, and changes no system files.
Important:
  1. Move this file to external media (a USB drive or another computer). Do not leave it only on this machine: if it really was compromised, an attacker can see and alter it.
  2. This package does NOT contain password hashes (/etc/shadow is not read), private keys, or the contents of authorized_keys (fingerprints only), or the files themselves (only hashes and attributes). Things like password= and token= in the text are also masked.
  3. Everything was collected locally; a compromised kernel (for example a kernel-level rootkit) can make what you see untrue. For serious forensics, collect evidence again from a clean external environment (a boot disc).

column2: Disconnecting the network stops the attacker from continuing to operate and from exfiltrating data. You can click "Cut network temporarily" below (it asks you to confirm first), or just unplug the network cable and turn off Wi-Fi. Do not use shutdown as a substitute for disconnecting.\nIf you already have pomelo-firewall installed, you can also use its "Block all inbound and outbound (keep local admin connection)". column1: 按「建立證據包」，把入侵檢查結果、你標記的日誌、時間線、行程與連線快照、已載入的核心模組、排程與服務清單、重要檔案的雜湊打包成一個檔案，並算出整包的 SHA-256。證據包「不含」密碼雜湊與私鑰。請把它搬到外部媒體（隨身碟或另一台電腦），不要只留在這台機器上。

The package does NOT contain password hashes or private keys. Move it to external media (a USB drive or another computer); do not leave it only on this machine.

column1:
假設攻擊者已經拿到這台電腦上能看到的一切。從另一台沒有問題的電腦，依序更換：
  • 本機使用者密碼（尤其是管理員與 root）
  • SSH 金鑰（在其他伺服器上移除這台的舊公開金鑰，重新產生一組）
  • 瀏覽器儲存的密碼與登入狀態、密碼管理員
  • 雲端帳號（電子郵件、雲端硬碟、程式碼託管、銀行）與 API 金鑰、存取權杖
  • 開啟雙重驗證。
不要在這台懷疑被入侵的電腦上做這些事。
column2:
Assume the attacker already has everything visible on this computer. From another computer that is known to be clean, change in this order:
  • Local user passwords (especially administrators and root)
  • SSH keys (remove this machine's old public key from other servers and generate a new one)
  • Passwords and sessions saved in browsers, and password managers
  • Cloud accounts (email, cloud storage, code hosting, banking), API keys and access tokens
  • Turn on two-factor authentication.
Do not do any of this on the computer you suspect is compromised.

column1: 已經被入侵的系統，無法保證清得乾淨（尤其是核心層的 rootkit）。最穩妥的做法：把重要資料備份（只備份資料檔，不要備份執行檔與設定），用乾淨的安裝光碟重新安裝；或還原到確定入侵發生之前的備份。重新安裝後，資料要先掃描再放回去，所有密碼與金鑰都用新的。
column2: A system that has been compromised cannot be guaranteed clean (especially against kernel-level rootkits). The safest approach: back up important data (data files only, not executables or settings), then reinstall from a clean installation disc, or restore from a backup made before the intrusion. After reinstalling, scan the data before putting it back, and use new passwords and keys everywhere.

column1: 依你的情況：公司或學校的電腦，立刻通知資訊或資安人員；有個人資料外洩的疑慮，依當地法規向主管機關通報；金融帳號有異常，聯絡該金融機構。可以向當地的資安事件通報單位、你的網路服務提供者或可信任的資安專業人員求助，並帶著證據包。保留所有可能相關的訊息與時間。
column2: Depending on your situation: for a company or school computer, notify IT or security staff immediately; if personal data may have leaked, report to the regulator as local law requires; if a financial account looks abnormal, contact the financial institution. You can ask your local security incident reporting center, your internet provider or a trusted security professional for help, and bring the evidence package. Keep all possibly related messages and times.

column1: 主機醫生在本機上做檢查，無法排除高明的入侵；不要把證據包放在受感染的機器上。通報時不要附上密碼與私鑰。
column2: Pomelo Doctor checks on this machine and cannot rule out a skilled intruder; do not keep the evidence package on an infected machine. Do not attach passwords or private keys when reporting.

column1: 已清除基準；下一次檢查會以目前的狀態重新建立。（基準代表「你當時信任的狀態」，如果當時已經被入侵，基準也會包含入侵留下的東西。）
column2: Baseline cleared; the next check will rebuild it from the current state. (The baseline represents "the state you trusted at the time"; if the machine was already compromised then, the baseline also contains what the intruder left behind.)

column1: 管理員那一份沒有取得（沒有授權或取消）；只顯示一般權限的結果。
column2: The administrator part was not obtained (not authorized or cancelled); only results at normal privilege are shown.

column1: 反向 shell（把殼層接到遠端的 /dev/tcp）
column2: Reverse shell (connecting a shell to a remote /dev/tcp)

column1: 極少數管理腳本會用 /dev/tcp 測試埠是否開著；如果同一行有 bash -i 與 >& 就幾乎一定是反向 shell
column2: A very few admin scripts use /dev/tcp to test whether a port is open; if the same line also has bash -i and >& it is almost certainly a reverse shell

column1: 用 nc／ncat 開反向或綁定 shell
column2: Opening a reverse or bind shell with nc/ncat

column1: nc 的 -e 在新版已移除；出現在排程或啟動檔裡很不尋常
column2: nc's -e was removed in newer versions; seeing it in a cron job or startup file is very unusual

column1: 用具名管道加 nc 接遠端 shell
column2: Connecting a remote shell with a named pipe and nc

column1: 用 socat 把殼層接出去
column2: Connecting a shell outward with socat

column1: socat 也有正當用途（轉接序列埠、測試），但 exec: 加 sh 很像後門
column2: socat has legitimate uses too (serial port relay, testing), but exec: with sh looks very much like a backdoor

column1: 用 Python 開 socket 並接殼層
column2: Opening a socket with Python and connecting a shell

column1: 用 Python 開 socket 並把輸入輸出接到 sh
column2: Opening a socket with Python and wiring input and output to sh

column1: 用 Perl 開 socket 並接殼層
column2: Opening a socket with Perl and connecting a shell

column1: 下載後直接交給 shell 執行（curl|sh）
column2: Download piped straight to a shell (curl|sh)

column1: 官方安裝腳本常教人這樣裝；但放進排程、啟動檔、服務就不尋常，因為內容隨時可以被對方換掉
column2: Official install scripts often tell people to do this; but inside a cron job, startup file or service it is unusual, because the content can be swapped by the other side at any time

column1: 下載後直接交給 bash 執行
下載後直接交給 shell 執行（wget|sh）
column2: Download piped straight to a shell (wget|sh)

column1: 下載後直接交給 shell 執行（wget -O- |）
column2: Download piped straight to a shell (wget -O- |)

column1: 把下載的內容用 eval 執行
下載檔案到暫存資料夾並執行
column2: Downloading a file to a temporary folder and running it

column1: 安裝腳本有時會先下載到 /tmp 再安裝，但放在排程或啟動檔裡不尋常
column2: Install scripts sometimes download to /tmp before installing, but inside a cron job or startup file it is unusual

column1: 把編碼過的內容解碼後直接執行（base64 -d | sh）
column2: Decoding encoded content and running it directly (base64 -d | sh)

column1: 少數管理腳本為了跳脫字元會這樣做
column2: A few admin scripts do this to get around escaping issues

column1: 把編碼過的內容解碼後直接執行
column2: Decoding encoded content and running it directly

column1: 把編碼過的內容解碼後直接執行（bash）
column2: Decoding encoded content and running it directly (bash)

column1: 用 eval 執行解碼後的內容
指令裡有挖礦礦池位址（stratum）
column2: The command contains a mining pool address (stratum)

column1: 指令像是挖礦程式的參數
column2: The command looks like crypto miner arguments

column1: 你自己研究挖礦程式時會出現
column2: This appears when you are researching crypto miners yourself

column1: 關掉或清除命令歷史（常見的掩蓋痕跡手法）
column2: Disabling or clearing command history (a common way to cover tracks)

column1: 有些人為了隱私會這樣設；只有放在不是你自己寫的地方才可疑
column2: Some people set this for privacy; it is only suspicious when it sits somewhere you did not write

column1: 把命令歷史導到 /dev/null（掩蓋痕跡）
把 sudo 換成別的程式（可能用來偷密碼）
column2: Replacing sudo with another program (may be used to steal passwords)

column1: 有人會設 alias sudo='sudo '（為了讓別名可用）；指到別的路徑才可疑
column2: Some people set alias sudo='sudo ' (so aliases keep working); it is only suspicious when it points to another path

column1: 把 ssh 換成別的程式（可能用來偷密碼）
column2: Replacing ssh with another program (may be used to steal passwords)

column1: 設定了 LD_PRELOAD（讓每個程式先載入某個函式庫，rootkit 常用）
column2: LD_PRELOAD is set (makes every program load a library first; commonly used by rootkits)

column1: libfaketime、jemalloc 等工具會設；請確認函式庫是你自己裝的
column2: Tools such as libfaketime and jemalloc set it; make sure you installed the library yourself

column1: 把暫存資料夾放進 PATH（讓裡面的程式優先被執行）
column2: Putting a temporary folder in PATH (so programs there run first)

column1: 把暫存資料夾放進 PATH
column2: Putting a temporary folder in PATH

column1: 執行 /dev/shm 裡的程式（記憶體磁碟，重開機就消失，惡意程式常用）
column2: Running a program from /dev/shm (a RAM disk that vanishes on reboot, commonly used by malware)

column1: 用 nohup 或背景執行暫存資料夾裡的程式
column2: Running a program from a temporary folder with nohup or in the background

column1: 透過 Tor 執行下載（隱藏來源）
column2: Running a download through Tor (hiding its origin)

column1: 你自己用 Tor 的話是正常的
column2: It is normal if you use Tor yourself

column1: 把公開金鑰附加到 authorized_keys（留後門的常見手法）
column2: Appending a public key to authorized_keys (a common way to leave a backdoor)

column1: 你自己寫的部署腳本可能會這樣做
column2: A deployment script you wrote yourself might do this

column1: 直接改 /etc/passwd 或 /etc/shadow（新增帳號）
替檔案加上 setuid（變成任何人執行都以 root 身分）
column2: Adding setuid to a file (it then runs as root for anyone)

column1: 安裝腳本有時會做；放在排程或啟動檔裡就很可疑
column2: Install scripts sometimes do this; inside a cron job or startup file it is very suspicious

column1: 把 shell 複製後加上 setuid（提權後門）
column2: Copying a shell and adding setuid (a privilege escalation backdoor)

column1: 載入了專有（非自由）授權的模組
column2: A module with a proprietary (non-free) license was loaded

column1: NVIDIA 顯示卡驅動、部分無線網卡與印表機驅動都會這樣；很常見
column2: NVIDIA graphics drivers, some Wi-Fi card and printer drivers do this; it is very common

column1: 有模組被「強制載入」（忽略版本檢查）
column2: A module was force-loaded (ignoring version checks)

column1: 自己編譯或舊驅動；一般桌面不會需要。請確認是你做的
column2: Self-built or old drivers; a typical desktop does not need this. Make sure you did it yourself

column1: 在多處理器系統上載入了只為單處理器編譯的模組
column2: A module compiled for a single processor was loaded on a multiprocessor system

column1: 非常少見，通常是很舊的驅動
column2: Very rare, usually a very old driver

column1: 開發或除錯時；一般使用不會
column2: During development or debugging; normal use does not do this

column1: 發生過硬體的機器檢查錯誤（MCE）
column2: A hardware machine check error (MCE) occurred

column1: 記憶體或 CPU 硬體問題，不是入侵
column2: A memory or CPU hardware problem, not an intrusion

column1: 發生過記憶體分頁錯誤
使用者要求標記（例如測試）
column2: Flagged at user request (for example, testing)

column1: 核心曾經發生 oops（嚴重錯誤）
column2: The kernel has had an oops (serious error)

column1: 驅動或硬體問題；攻擊嘗試利用核心漏洞時也可能留下
column2: A driver or hardware problem; an attack attempting to exploit a kernel bug can also leave this
The kernel has shown a warning (WARN)
Very common: a minor driver issue

column1: 載入了 staging（試驗中）驅動
載入了核心之外編譯的模組（out-of-tree）
column2: A module built outside the kernel (out-of-tree) was loaded

column1: NVIDIA、VirtualBox、VMware、ZFS、DKMS 安裝的驅動都會這樣；很常見
column2: NVIDIA, VirtualBox, VMware, ZFS and DKMS-installed drivers all do this; it is very common

column1: 載入了沒有簽章的模組
沒開 Secure Boot 時自己編譯的驅動；有簽章但金鑰不在清單上時也會；rootkit 通常也沒簽章
column2: Drivers you built yourself without Secure Boot; also when signed but the key is not on the list; rootkits are usually unsigned too

column1: 企業的核心熱更新服務
核心用了 randstruct 外掛
column2: The kernel uses the randstruct plugin
The kernel is in test mode

column1: 發現 %d 個用混淆名稱（只有點、空白或控制字元）的檔案或資料夾
column2: Found %d files or folders with obfuscated names (only dots, spaces or control characters)

column1: 名稱像「. 」「.. 」「...」或帶控制字元，是為了讓人在檔案清單裡看漏、或以為是上一層資料夾；攻擊者常把工具藏在裡面。
column2: Names like ". ", ".. ", "..." or with control characters are meant to be overlooked in file lists, or mistaken for the parent folder; attackers often hide tools inside them.

column1: 別直接刪除；先保存證據，再用 ls -la 與 ls -b 看裡面有什麼。
column2: Do not delete directly; preserve evidence first, then use ls -la and ls -b to see what is inside.

column1: 極少數正常軟體會這樣命名；如果是你自己建立的才標為正常。
column2: Very few legitimate programs name things like this; mark as normal only if you created it yourself.

column1: 系統目錄裡有 %d 個隱藏的資料夾或檔案
column2: %d hidden folders or files in system directories

column1: /usr、/etc 這類系統目錄裡通常沒有以點開頭的資料夾；攻擊者有時把工具藏在這裡，因為很少人會去看。
column2: System directories such as /usr and /etc normally have no folders starting with a dot; attackers sometimes hide tools here because few people look.

column1: 確認這些是軟體建立的；不認得請看裡面有什麼。
column2: Confirm these were created by software; if you do not recognize them, look at what is inside.

column1: etckeeper、dwz、build-id 等工具會建立隱藏資料夾（已排除常見的）；自己裝的軟體也可能。
column2: Tools such as etckeeper, dwz and build-id create hidden folders (common ones are excluded); software you installed yourself may too.

column1: 暫存資料夾裡有 %d 個隱藏的資料夾或可執行檔
column2: %d hidden folders or executables in temporary folders

column1: 惡意程式常把自己和工具藏在 /tmp、/dev/shm 的隱藏資料夾裡。許多合法的軟體也會，所以只是提示。
column2: Malware often hides itself and its tools in hidden folders under /tmp and /dev/shm. Many legitimate programs do too, so this is only a hint.

column1: 看看有沒有不認得的；暫存資料夾的內容重新開機會清掉（/dev/shm 與多數 /tmp）。
column2: Look for anything you do not recognize; temporary folders are cleared on reboot (/dev/shm and most of /tmp).

column1: 瀏覽器、Electron 應用程式、IDE、容器工具都會在 /tmp 建隱藏資料夾。
column2: Browsers, Electron apps, IDEs and container tools all create hidden folders in /tmp.

column1: 最近 %d 天內有 %d 個重要的系統設定檔被修改過
column2: %d important system configuration files were modified in the last %d days

column1: 帳號、sudo、SSH、PAM、hosts 這些檔案被改，是入侵後最常見的動作（新增帳號、開後門、轉向網址）。這裡只看「修改時間」，不讀 /etc/shadow 的內容。
column2: Changes to accounts, sudo, SSH, PAM and hosts files are the most common actions after an intrusion (adding accounts, opening backdoors, redirecting addresses). This only looks at modification times; it does not read the contents of /etc/shadow.

column1: 回想最近有沒有新增使用者、改過密碼、設定過 sudo／SSH；沒有的話，到日誌檢視器看那個時間點前後有誰登入。
column2: Think back: did you recently add users, change passwords, or configure sudo or SSH? If not, check in the log viewer who logged in around that time.

column1: 新增使用者、改密碼、安裝或更新軟體、使用網路管理員，都會讓這些檔案的修改時間變新。
column2: Adding users, changing passwords, installing or updating software and using network managers all make these files' modification times newer.

column1: 暫存或家目錄裡有 setuid 檔案：%s
column2: setuid file in a temporary folder or home folder: %s

column1: setuid 檔案不論誰執行都以擁有者（常是 root）身分執行。放在暫存或家目錄，通常是攻擊者留下的提權後門（例如複製一份 shell 再加上 setuid）。
column2: A setuid file runs as its owner (often root) no matter who runs it. In a temporary or home folder it is usually a privilege escalation backdoor left by an attacker (for example a copy of a shell with setuid added).

column1: 別執行它；保存證據。可以先用 ls -l 與 sha256sum 記錄它。
column2: Do not run it; preserve evidence. You can first record it with ls -l and sha256sum.

column1: 極少數：你自己測試用的 setuid 程式。
column2: Very rare: a setuid program you are testing yourself.

column1: 跟第一次檢查比，多了一個 setuid 檔案。新安裝的軟體可能帶 setuid（例如 sudo、mount 類工具），但攻擊者提權也常這樣。
column2: Compared with the first check, there is one more setuid file. Newly installed software may carry setuid (for example sudo or mount tools), but attackers often do this to escalate privileges too.

column1: 想想最近有沒有安裝新軟體；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Think about whether you installed new software recently; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 安裝或更新軟體（套件管理員）後出現的 setuid 檔案是正常的。
column2: A setuid file that appears after installing or updating software (package manager) is normal.

column1: 有 %d 個系統檔案或資料夾任何人都能寫入
column2: %d system files or folders are writable by anyone

column1: 系統目錄與設定檔該只有 root 能改。任何人可寫，代表一般使用者（或入侵的程式）能改系統行為、替換執行檔，等於提權。
column2: System directories and configuration files should be changeable only by root. If anyone can write to them, ordinary users (or a compromised program) can change system behavior and replace executables, which amounts to privilege escalation.

column1: 用 chmod o-w 取消其他人的寫入權限；並想想為什麼會被改成這樣。
column2: Use chmod o-w to remove write permission for others, and think about why it was changed this way.

column1: 極少數系統刻意開放（例如某些共享的 /etc 子資料夾）；Docker 或 k3s 的 socket 不在這裡。
column2: A very few systems do this deliberately (for example some shared /etc subfolders); Docker and k3s sockets are not listed here.

column1: /dev 裡有 %d 個一般檔案（正常只會有裝置檔）
column2: %d regular files in /dev (normally there are only device files)

column1: /dev 應該只放裝置檔案。出現一般檔案，常是攻擊者把工具或資料藏在這裡，因為很少有人會看。
column2: /dev should hold only device files. Regular files there are often tools or data hidden by an attacker, because few people look.

column1: 保存證據；看看它是什麼（file、strings）。不要執行。
column2: Preserve evidence; see what it is (file, strings). Do not run it.

column1: 某些舊的系統腳本或容器初始化會在 /dev 留下一般檔案。
column2: Some old system scripts or container init leave regular files in /dev.

column1: 網頁目錄裡有 %d 個檔案含有網頁木馬（webshell）的常見特徵
column2: %d files in web directories contain common webshell signatures

column1: 網頁木馬讓攻擊者透過網站執行指令。這裡只是比對常見的特徵字串（例如 eval(base64_decode…），結果是「可疑」，不是確定。
column2: A webshell lets an attacker run commands through a website. This only matches common signature strings (for example eval(base64_decode...); the result is "suspicious", not certain.

column1: 打開檔案看是不是你的程式；不是的話保存證據、換掉被入侵的網站程式，並更新網站套件（WordPress 外掛等）。
column2: Open the file and check whether it is your code; if not, preserve evidence, replace the compromised site code, and update site packages (WordPress plugins and so on).

column1: 有些合法的外掛、混淆過的商業程式或安裝程式會用 eval 與 base64，容易誤判。
column2: Some legitimate plugins, obfuscated commercial code or installers use eval and base64, so false positives are easy.

column1: 網站的上傳資料夾裡有 %d 個 PHP 檔
column2: %d PHP files in the site's upload folders

column1: 上傳資料夾只該放圖片與文件；裡面有 PHP 腳本，是攻擊者透過上傳漏洞放網頁木馬的典型情形。
column2: Upload folders should hold only images and documents; PHP scripts there are the classic case of an attacker planting a webshell through an upload vulnerability.

column1: 確認這些檔案是不是網站自己的；不是的話保存證據並移除。
column2: Check whether these files belong to the site itself; if not, preserve evidence and remove them.

column1: 少數外掛會把自己的 PHP 檔放在 uploads 或 cache。
column2: A few plugins put their own PHP files in uploads or cache.

column1: 系統關鍵檔案內容跟套件記錄的不一樣：%s
column2: Critical system file differs from the package record: %s

column1: 系統檔案內容跟套件記錄的不一樣：%s
column2: System file differs from the package record: %s

column1: 套件裝了這個檔案，現在卻不在；可能是被移除，也可能被人刪掉。
column2: A package installed this file but it is no longer there; it may have been removed, or deleted by someone.

column1: 套件管理員記得每個檔案原本的內容。系統程式或函式庫被換成別的內容，是木馬與 rootkit 最典型的植入方式（例如換掉 ps、ls、sshd 來隱藏自己）。
column2: The package manager remembers each file's original contents. System programs or libraries replaced with other content are the classic way trojans and rootkits are planted (for example replacing ps, ls or sshd to hide themselves).

column1: 如果你沒有移除過這個軟體，重新安裝那個套件即可；同時留意有沒有其他異常。
column2: If you did not remove this software, just reinstall that package; also watch for other anomalies.

column1: 不要在這台機器上直接重新安裝覆蓋：先保存證據（建立證據包）。確認不是你自己改過（例如手動修補、換過函式庫）。確定是被換掉時，請依「被攻擊時的處置」處理。
column2: Do not reinstall over it on this machine right away: preserve evidence first (create an evidence package). Make sure you did not change it yourself (for example manual patching or swapping a library). If it was indeed replaced, follow "What to do if under attack".

column1: 你自己手動修補、用 dpkg-divert／替代檔取代、或套件更新到一半中斷，都會讓雜湊不符。
column2: Manual patches, dpkg-divert or replacement files, or a package update interrupted halfway will all cause hash mismatches.

column1: 原本是一般檔案，現在不是（可能被換成連結）
column2: Was a regular file, now it is not (possibly replaced by a link)

column1: 另外還有 %d 個檔案的內容跟套件記錄不一樣（上面只列前 %d 個）
column2: Another %d files differ from the package record (only the first %d are listed above)

column1: 大量系統檔案內容不符，常見於套件庫損壞、磁碟錯誤，或系統被大範圍修改。
column2: Many system files differing is common with a damaged package repository, disk errors, or a system modified at large scale.

column1: 用 pomelo-doctor --intrusion --json 看完整清單；也可以重新安裝受影響的套件（保存證據後）。
column2: See the full list with pomelo-doctor --intrusion --json; you can also reinstall the affected packages (after preserving evidence).

column1: 有 %d 個系統檔案沒有權限讀取，沒有驗證
column2: %d system files could not be read and were not verified

column1: 驗證了 %d 個系統檔案（%d 個用快取、讀了 %lld MB），%d 個不符
column2: Verified %d system files (%d from cache, read %lld MB), %d mismatched

column1: 用 dpkg 記錄的 MD5 比對系統執行檔與關鍵函式庫。注意：記錄本身也在這台機器上，攻擊者若同時改了記錄就驗不出來。
column2: Compares system executables and key libraries against the MD5 records of dpkg. Note: the records are also on this machine; if an attacker changed them too, the mismatch cannot be detected.

column1: 重點二進位（系統執行檔與關鍵函式庫）；加 --deep 驗證全部
column2: Key binaries (system executables and key libraries); add --deep to verify everything

column1: rpm -V 沒有在時限內完成或無法執行，沒有驗證系統檔案
column2: rpm -V did not finish in time or could not run; system files were not verified

column1: 用 pomelo-doctor --intrusion --json 看完整清單；保存證據後再重新安裝受影響的套件。
column2: See the full list with pomelo-doctor --intrusion --json; reinstall the affected packages after preserving evidence.

column1: %d 個設定檔跟套件原本的內容不同（設定檔本來就會被使用者修改）
column2: %d configuration files differ from the package's originals (configuration files are meant to be edited by users)

column1: 設定檔（/etc 底下）被你或管理員改過是正常的，這裡只列出來讓你看有沒有不認得的。
column2: Configuration files (under /etc) edited by you or an administrator are normal; they are only listed here so you can check for any you do not recognize.

column1: 不認得的設定檔改動，用 rpm -V 套件名 與 diff 看一下。
column2: For configuration changes you do not recognize, use rpm -V package-name and diff to look.

column1: 用 rpm -V 驗證了系統檔案，%d 個執行檔或函式庫不符
column2: Verified system files with rpm -V; %d executables or libraries mismatched

column1: 用 rpm 資料庫記錄的摘要比對。注意：資料庫本身也在這台機器上，攻擊者若同時改了資料庫就驗不出來。
column2: Compares against the digests in the rpm database. Note: the database is also on this machine; if an attacker changed it too, the mismatch cannot be detected.
Key packages (bash, coreutils, openssh, sudo, pam, glibc, systemd...); add --deep to verify everything

column1: 系統執行檔目錄裡有 %d 個不屬於任何套件的檔案（%d 個是程式、%d 個是腳本）
column2: %d files in system executable directories do not belong to any package (%d programs, %d scripts)

column1: /usr/bin 這類目錄的檔案該由套件管理員安裝。不屬於任何套件的執行檔，可能是你手動安裝的軟體，也可能是被放進去的木馬。
column2: Files in directories like /usr/bin should be installed by the package manager. An executable that belongs to no package may be software you installed by hand, or a trojan that was dropped there.

column1: 看一下有沒有不認得的名字；自己手動安裝的軟體標為正常即可。
column2: Look for names you do not recognize; just mark software you installed by hand as normal.

column1: 手動安裝的軟體（.run 安裝檔、直接複製的工具）與某些廠商的安裝腳本會把執行檔放進 /usr/bin。
column2: Manually installed software (.run installers, tools copied in directly) and some vendors' install scripts put executables in /usr/bin.

column1: 找不到套件管理員（dpkg 或 rpm），無法驗證系統檔案
column2: No package manager (dpkg or rpm) found; system files cannot be verified

column1: 有 %d 個載入中的核心模組，不在這個核心的模組清單裡
column2: %d loaded kernel modules are not in this kernel's module list

column1: 正常的模組都來自核心套件，會列在 modules.dep。不在清單裡的模組是用 insmod 手動載入的，或來自別處；rootkit 就是用這種方式進核心。
column2: Legitimate modules all come from the kernel package and are listed in modules.dep. A module not in the list was loaded by hand with insmod or came from elsewhere; this is exactly how rootkits get into the kernel.

column1: 確認這些模組是你自己（或廠商驅動）載入的；不認得請保存證據，並用外部乾淨環境檢查。
column2: Confirm you (or a vendor driver) loaded these modules; if you do not recognize them, preserve evidence and check from a clean external environment.

column1: 手動編譯的驅動、剛更新了核心但還沒重開機（模組檔已換成新版）、容器或虛擬機的客體驅動，都會讓模組不在清單裡。
column2: Self-built drivers, a kernel just updated but not yet rebooted (module files already replaced by the new version), and guest drivers in containers or virtual machines all cause modules to be missing from the list.

column1: 找不到目前核心的模組清單（可能剛更新核心還沒重開機，或在容器裡）
column2: Could not find the module list for the running kernel (the kernel may have just been updated without a reboot, or this is inside a container)

column1: 有 %d 個核心模組被從模組清單中藏起來
column2: %d kernel modules are hidden from the module list

column1: /sys/module 顯示這些模組已載入，但 lsmod（/proc/modules）沒有列出。rootkit 載入後常把自己從清單移除來躲避檢查。
column2: /sys/module shows these modules as loaded, but lsmod (/proc/modules) does not list them. Rootkits often remove themselves from the list after loading to evade checks.

column1: 先保存證據並斷開網路，再用外部乾淨的環境（開機光碟）檢查；不要在這台機器上嘗試卸載。
column2: Preserve evidence and disconnect the network first, then check from a clean external environment (a boot disc); do not try to unload them on this machine.

column1: 模組剛好在讀取過程中被載入或卸載時可能短暫不一致；重新檢查一次若仍在才需要在意。
column2: If a module is loaded or unloaded exactly while being read, the two views can briefly disagree; only worry if it still shows after checking again.

column1: 核心有被「標記」（tainted=%ld），原因看起來是正常的驅動
column2: The kernel is "tainted" (tainted=%ld), and the cause looks like normal drivers

column1: 核心被標記為 tainted（%ld）：載入過非標準的東西
column2: The kernel is tainted (%ld): something non-standard was loaded

column1: tainted 是核心自己記的「曾經載入過不屬於官方核心的東西」。多半是顯示卡驅動（NVIDIA）、虛擬機驅動（VirtualBox）這類合法的外部模組；但 rootkit 載入時也會留下這個標記。
column2: Tainted is the kernel's own record that "something outside the official kernel was loaded". It is mostly legitimate external modules such as graphics drivers (NVIDIA) and virtual machine drivers (VirtualBox); but a rootkit also leaves this flag when loaded.

column1: 不用處理：這是安裝了廠商驅動的正常現象。
column2: Nothing to do: this is normal when vendor drivers are installed.

column1: 確認你有沒有裝過外部驅動（NVIDIA、VirtualBox、VMware、ZFS）；沒有的話，看一下「不在清單的模組」那一項。
column2: Check whether you installed any external drivers (NVIDIA, VirtualBox, VMware, ZFS); if not, look at the "modules not in the list" item.

column1: NVIDIA 專有驅動、VirtualBox、VMware、ZFS、DKMS 安裝的任何驅動，都會讓核心被標記，這很常見。
column2: NVIDIA proprietary drivers, VirtualBox, VMware, ZFS and any driver installed by DKMS taint the kernel; this is very common.

column1: 開啟（只允許簽章過的核心模組）
column2: On (only signed kernel modules are allowed)

column1: 關閉（任何模組都能載入）
不是 UEFI 開機（沒有這項保護）
column2: Not booted with UEFI (no such protection)

column1: （核心位址對所有人公開，利用核心漏洞比較容易）
column2: (kernel addresses are visible to everyone, which makes exploiting kernel bugs easier)

column1: 這些設定決定核心有多難被利用或被載入惡意模組；不是入侵跡象，只是看看防護有沒有開。
column2: These settings determine how hard it is to exploit the kernel or load a malicious module; they are not signs of intrusion, just a look at whether the protections are on.

column1: Secure Boot 關閉時，想載入未簽章模組的攻擊者更容易成功；可以考慮在韌體設定裡開啟。
column2: With Secure Boot off, an attacker trying to load an unsigned module has an easier time; consider turning it on in the firmware settings.

column1: 核心模組目錄裡有 %d 個不屬於任何套件的模組檔
column2: %d module files in the kernel module directory belong to no package

column1: 模組檔該由核心套件提供；手動放進去的檔案可能是自己編譯的驅動，也可能是被放進去的惡意模組。
column2: Module files should come from the kernel package; a file put there by hand may be a driver you built, or a malicious module that was planted.

column1: 確認這些是你編譯或廠商提供的驅動。
column2: Confirm these are drivers you built or that a vendor provided.

column1: DKMS、akmods 編譯的驅動（NVIDIA、VirtualBox）本來就不屬於套件。
column2: Drivers built by DKMS or akmods (NVIDIA, VirtualBox) never belong to a package.

column1: 這個位置的內容會在開機、登入或排程時自動執行；攻擊者很愛把後門放在這裡，因為重新開機之後仍然有效。
column2: Content at this location runs automatically at boot, at login or on a schedule; attackers love to put backdoors here because they keep working after a reboot.

column1: 打開這個檔案確認每一行是不是你（或你信任的軟體）寫的；不認得就先別刪，備份一份給懂的人看，再移除並檢查有沒有被入侵。
column2: Open this file and check whether each line was written by you (or software you trust); if you do not recognize it, do not delete it yet: back it up for someone who knows, then remove it and check whether the machine was compromised.

column1: 如果那一行是你自己寫的（例如部署腳本），可以標為正常。
column2: If the line is one you wrote yourself (for example a deployment script), you can mark it as normal.

column1: 排程會執行暫存資料夾裡的程式：%s
column2: A cron job runs a program in a temporary folder: %s

column1: 排程會執行隱藏路徑裡的程式：%s
column2: A cron job runs a program in a hidden path: %s

column1: 暫存資料夾與隱藏資料夾不是正常軟體放程式的地方；惡意程式常把自己放在那裡再用排程定時啟動。
column2: Temporary folders and hidden folders are not where normal software puts its programs; malware often puts itself there and starts itself on a schedule with cron.

column1: 確認這條排程是不是你加的；不認得的話先用 crontab -l 或打開檔案看完整內容、保留證據，再移除，並檢查那個檔案是什麼。
column2: Check whether you added this cron job; if you do not recognize it, use crontab -l or open the file to see the full content, keep evidence, then remove it and check what that file is.

column1: 有些備份或同步工具會把腳本放在隱藏資料夾；是你自己設的可以標為正常。
column2: Some backup or sync tools put scripts in hidden folders; if you set it up yourself you can mark it as normal.

column1: 新排程要確認是你做的：木馬很常用定時排程讓自己活下去，或定時把後門拉回來。
column2: Confirm new cron jobs are your own: trojans often use scheduled jobs to stay alive or to pull the backdoor back on a schedule.

column1: 用 crontab -l（或打開那個檔案）確認每一行；是你加的就標為正常。
column2: Check each line with crontab -l (or by opening the file); mark it as normal if you added it.

column1: 你自己新增排程、或安裝的軟體加了排程都會出現。
column2: It appears when you add a cron job yourself, or when software you installed adds one.

column1: 排程檔需要管理員權限才讀得到：%s
column2: Cron file needs administrator rights to read: %s

column1: systemd 單元「%s」的啟動指令有可疑內容：%s
column2: The start command of systemd unit "%s" has suspicious content: %s

column1: systemd 單元「%s」會執行暫存資料夾裡的程式
column2: systemd unit "%s" runs a program in a temporary folder

column1: systemd 單元「%s」會執行隱藏路徑裡的程式
column2: systemd unit "%s" runs a program in a hidden path

column1: systemd 單元會在開機或定時自動啟動；惡意程式常裝成一個看起來正常的服務，重開機後繼續在背景執行。
column2: systemd units start automatically at boot or on a schedule; malware often installs itself as a normal-looking service so it keeps running in the background after a reboot.

column1: 用 systemctl cat 看完整單元、確認它是你（或你裝的軟體）建立的；不認得就先 systemctl disable --now 停用並保留檔案當證據，再檢查它執行的程式。
column2: Use systemctl cat to see the full unit and confirm you (or software you installed) created it; if you do not recognize it, first systemctl disable --now to disable it and keep the file as evidence, then check the program it runs.

column1: 自己寫的服務、開發用的服務常放在家目錄；確認是你的就可以標為正常。
column2: Services you wrote yourself and development services are often kept in the home folder; if you are sure it is yours, you can mark it as normal.

column1: 單元「%s」名字像系統服務，但不屬於任何套件
column2: Unit "%s" has a system-service-like name but belongs to no package

column1: 攻擊者常把後門取成像 systemd-xxx、sshd、dbus 之類的名字，讓人一眼看過去以為是系統的。
column2: Attackers often name a backdoor something like systemd-xxx, sshd or dbus so that a glance makes people think it is part of the system.

column1: 用 systemctl cat 看它執行什麼；如果是你自己（或公司）建立的就標為正常，不是的話請先停用並保留證據。
column2: Use systemctl cat to see what it runs; if you (or your company) created it, mark it as normal; if not, disable it first and keep evidence.

column1: 自己寫的服務也可能取這種名字；Docker、k3s 等官方安裝腳本裝的單元不屬於套件但是正常的。
column2: Services you wrote yourself may use such names too; units installed by the official install scripts of Docker, k3s and similar do not belong to a package but are normal.

column1: 系統單元目錄裡有不屬於任何套件的單元：%s
column2: Units in the system unit directory that belong to no package: %s

column1: 這個資料夾是給套件放單元的；有檔案不是任何套件裝的，可能是手動放進去的（正常的軟體會放在 /etc/systemd/system）。
column2: This folder is for packages to put units in; a file that no package installed may have been placed by hand (legitimate software puts them in /etc/systemd/system).

column1: 確認來源；不認得就停用並保留證據。
column2: Confirm where it came from; if you do not recognize it, disable it and keep evidence.

column1: 手動安裝的軟體（例如 .run 安裝檔）有時會把單元放在這裡。
column2: Manually installed software (for example .run installers) sometimes puts units here.

column1: 最近新增或修改了單元：%s
新出現的自動啟動項目要確認是你做的：木馬很常用新增單元的方式留下後門。
column2: Newly appearing autostart items should be confirmed as yours: trojans often leave a backdoor by adding a unit.

column1: 確認是你或你裝的軟體建立的；是的話標為正常。
column2: Confirm you or software you installed created it; if so, mark it as normal.

column1: 你自己新增服務、安裝了不透過套件管理員的軟體，都會出現這一項。
column2: This appears when you add a service yourself or install software that bypasses the package manager.

column1: 有 %d 個不屬於套件的自訂單元（自動啟動項目）
column2: %d custom units (autostart items) belong to no package

column1: 這只是清單：自己裝的服務（Docker、k3s、你寫的腳本）都在這裡；看一下有沒有不認得的。
column2: This is only a list: services you installed yourself (Docker, k3s, your own scripts) are all here; look for any you do not recognize.

column1: 不認得的單元，用 systemctl cat 名稱 看它做什麼。
column2: For a unit you do not recognize, use systemctl cat name to see what it does.

column1: 最近新增了登入時執行的腳本：%s
column2: A script that runs at login was recently added: %s

column1: /etc/profile.d 的腳本每個人登入時都會執行，是放後門的好地方。
column2: Scripts in /etc/profile.d run for everyone at login, which makes them a good place for a backdoor.

column1: 確認是你或你裝的軟體加的。
column2: Confirm you or software you installed added it.

column1: 自己加的環境設定（例如 JAVA_HOME）會這樣。
column2: Environment settings you added yourself (for example JAVA_HOME) will look like this.

column1: 有些使用者的家目錄需要管理員權限才讀得到（含 root）
column2: Some users' home folders (including root) need administrator rights to read

column1: ld.so.preload 會讓系統上「每一個」程式啟動時先載入這個函式庫；這是 rootkit 隱藏行程、檔案與連線的經典手法。正常系統沒有這個檔案。
column2: ld.so.preload makes "every" program on the system load this library first when it starts; this is the classic rootkit way to hide processes, files and connections. A normal system does not have this file.

column1: 別直接刪除。先保存證據（建立證據包）、斷開網路，再用外部乾淨的環境檢查；如果你確定這個函式庫是你自己裝的（例如除錯工具），可以標為正常。
column2: Do not delete it directly. First preserve evidence (create an evidence package) and disconnect the network, then check from a clean external environment; if you are sure you installed this library yourself (for example a debugging tool), you can mark it as normal.

column1: 極少數安全軟體或除錯工具會用它（例如某些 EDR 代理程式）。如果是你公司裝的，請向管理員確認。
column2: A very few security or debugging tools use it (for example some EDR agents). If your company installed it, confirm with your administrator.

column1: 函式庫搜尋路徑包含不尋常的位置：%s
column2: The library search path includes an unusual location: %s

column1: 系統找函式庫時會先看這些資料夾；如果裡面有同名的假函式庫，所有程式都會載入它（函式庫劫持）。
column2: When the system looks for libraries it checks these folders first; if a fake library of the same name is in there, every program will load it (library hijacking).

column1: 確認是你加的；不是的話請移除該行並檢查那個資料夾裡有什麼。
column2: Confirm you added it; if not, remove the line and check what is in that folder.

column1: 自己編譯的軟體有時會把它的 lib 資料夾加進來。
column2: Software you built yourself sometimes adds its lib folder here.

column1: 透過環境變數讓程式先載入指定的函式庫，是 rootkit 與函式庫劫持的常見手法。
column2: Making programs load a given library first through an environment variable is a common rootkit and library hijacking technique.

column1: 確認這是你設的；不是的話請移除並檢查函式庫。
column2: Confirm you set this; if not, remove it and check the library.

column1: 某些開發環境、遊戲平台、除錯工具會設。
column2: Some development environments, game platforms and debugging tools set it.

column1: PAM 驗證規則裡有「直接放行」：任何人都可能不用密碼通過
column2: The PAM authentication rules contain a "let through directly" entry: anyone may pass without a password

column1: pam_permit 加上 sufficient 的意思是「只要走到這一行就算驗證成功」。這是把登入、sudo 或 su 變成免密碼的常見後門。
column2: pam_permit with sufficient means "reaching this line counts as successful authentication". It is a common backdoor that makes login, sudo or su passwordless.

column1: 別直接修改；先保存證據並斷網。這種設定幾乎不會是正常的。
column2: Do not modify it directly; preserve evidence and disconnect the network. This kind of setting is almost never legitimate.

column1: 極少數特殊的單機展示或自動化環境會這樣設。
column2: A very few special standalone demo or automation environments set it this way.

column1: PAM 規則會在驗證時執行可疑的程式
column2: A PAM rule runs a suspicious program during authentication

column1: pam_exec 能在你每次登入、sudo 時執行任何程式，這是竊取密碼的後門手法。
column2: pam_exec can run any program every time you log in or use sudo; this is a password-stealing backdoor technique.

column1: 確認這條規則是你設的；不是的話請保存證據並移除。
column2: Confirm you set this rule; if not, preserve evidence and remove it.

column1: 有些環境用 pam_exec 做稽核或掛載家目錄。
column2: Some environments use pam_exec for auditing or mounting home folders.

column1: PAM 規則載入了系統目錄以外的模組：%s
column2: A PAM rule loads a module from outside the system directory: %s

column1: PAM 模組正常放在系統的 security 資料夾；指到別處的模組可能是偷密碼或繞過驗證的後門。
column2: PAM modules normally live in the system's security folder; a module pointing elsewhere may be a backdoor that steals passwords or bypasses authentication.

column1: 確認這個模組是你裝的；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Confirm you installed this module; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 企業的單一登入軟體有時把模組放在 /opt。
column2: Enterprise single sign-on software sometimes puts modules in /opt.

column1: PAM 模組「%s」不屬於任何套件
column2: PAM module "%s" belongs to no package

column1: PAM 模組能看到你輸入的每一個密碼，也能決定誰通過驗證；不是套件裝進來的模組，是後門的常見形式。
column2: A PAM module can see every password you type and decide who passes authentication; a module that was not installed by a package is a common form of backdoor.

column1: 確認它是你自己編譯或公司提供的；不是的話請保存證據並用乾淨環境檢查。
column2: Confirm you built it yourself or your company provided it; if not, preserve evidence and check from a clean environment.

column1: 自己編譯安裝的驗證模組（例如公司內部的單一登入）會出現。
column2: Self-built authentication modules (for example internal company single sign-on) will show up.

column1: sudo 設定讓 LD_PRELOAD 傳進特權指令（可用來提權）
column2: The sudo configuration passes LD_PRELOAD into privileged commands (can be used to escalate privileges)

column1: sudoers 讓「所有人」不用密碼就能 sudo
column2: sudoers lets "everyone" use sudo without a password

column1: sudoers 新增了免密碼 sudo 的規則
column2: sudoers gained a passwordless sudo rule

column1: 免密碼 sudo 代表一旦有人進入你的帳號，就能直接取得 root，不會再被擋下。
column2: Passwordless sudo means that once someone gets into your account, they can get root directly with nothing stopping them.

column1: 確認是你設的；不是的話請保存證據，並用 visudo 移除。
column2: Confirm you set this; if not, preserve evidence and remove it with visudo.

column1: 雲端主機（cloud-init）、自動化部署會設免密碼 sudo。
column2: Cloud hosts (cloud-init) and automated deployments set passwordless sudo.

column1: sudoers 需要管理員權限才讀得到
column2: sudoers needs administrator rights to read

column1: %s 的 authorized_keys 別人也能寫入
column2: The authorized_keys of %s is writable by others

column1: 任何能寫入這個檔案的人都能替自己加登入金鑰，等於拿到這個帳號。
column2: Anyone who can write to this file can add a login key for themselves, which is the same as getting this account.

column1: 改成只有擁有者能寫：chmod 600 authorized_keys，並檢查裡面有沒有不認得的金鑰。
column2: Make it writable only by the owner: chmod 600 authorized_keys, and check for keys you do not recognize.

column1: %s 的 SSH 金鑰帶有 environment= 選項（可用來載入惡意函式庫）
column2: An SSH key of %s has an environment= option (can be used to load a malicious library)

column1: %s 的 SSH 金鑰帶有可疑的 command= 前綴
column2: An SSH key of %s has a suspicious command= prefix

column1: 金鑰前面的選項可以在登入時強制執行指令；攻擊者用它在登入時啟動後門。
column2: Options in front of a key can force a command at login; attackers use this to start a backdoor at login.

column1: 確認這把金鑰是你加的；不是的話請保存證據並刪掉那一行。
column2: Confirm you added this key; if not, preserve evidence and delete that line.

column1: 備份工具（borg、rsync）與 git-shell 會合法地使用 command=。
column2: Backup tools (borg, rsync) and git-shell use command= legitimately.

column1: %s 新增了帶 command= 限制的 SSH 金鑰
column2: %s gained an SSH key with a command= restriction

column1: 帶 command= 的金鑰只能執行指定指令，通常是備份或自動化用；仍要確認是你加的。
column2: A key with command= can only run the specified command, usually for backups or automation; still confirm that you added it.

column1: root 新增了一把 SSH 登入金鑰
column2: root gained a new SSH login key

column1: %s 新增了一把 SSH 登入金鑰
column2: %s gained a new SSH login key

column1: 有了金鑰，持有的人不用密碼就能登入這個帳號，而且重設密碼也擋不住；這是攻擊者最常留下的後門之一。
column2: With a key, whoever holds it can log in to this account without a password, and resetting the password does not stop them; this is one of the backdoors attackers leave most often.

column1: 確認是你自己加的；不是的話刪掉那一行，並檢查有沒有被入侵。
column2: Confirm you added it yourself; if not, delete that line and check whether the machine was compromised.

column1: 你自己換電腦、加了新裝置的金鑰時會出現。
column2: It appears when you switch computers or add a key for a new device.

column1: 其他使用者與 root 的 authorized_keys 需要管理員權限才讀得到
column2: authorized_keys of other users and root need administrator rights to read

column1: 帳號「%s」的 UID 是 0（等於 root）
column2: Account "%s" has UID 0 (the same as root)

column1: UID 0 就是系統管理員。除了 root 以外，正常系統不會有第二個 UID 0 的帳號；這是常見的後門帳號。
column2: UID 0 is the system administrator. Apart from root, a normal system does not have a second UID 0 account; this is a common backdoor account.

column1: 先保存證據、斷開網路，再用外部乾淨的環境處理；不要直接刪除帳號。
column2: Preserve evidence and disconnect the network first, then handle it from a clean external environment; do not delete the account directly.

column1: 極少數舊系統刻意設了 toor 這類備用帳號；你確定是你設的才標為正常。
column2: A very few old systems deliberately set a spare account such as toor; mark as normal only if you are sure you set it.

column1: 系統帳號「%s」有可以登入的 shell（%s）
column2: System account "%s" has a login shell (%s)

column1: 系統帳號（UID 小於 1000）通常是 nologin：只給服務用，不能登入。有登入 shell 的系統帳號可能是攻擊者新增的後門。
column2: System accounts (UID below 1000) are normally nologin: they are for services only and cannot log in. A system account with a login shell may be a backdoor added by an attacker.

column1: 確認這個帳號是你（或某個服務的安裝說明）建立的；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Confirm you (or some service's install instructions) created this account; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 資料庫、git 伺服器等服務有時刻意給系統帳號 shell。
column2: Services such as databases and git servers sometimes deliberately give system accounts a shell.

column1: 入侵者常新增一個帳號當作之後回來的入口。如果你沒有新增過帳號，請確認。
column2: Intruders often add an account as a way to come back later. If you did not add an account, please confirm.

column1: 確認是你或家人新增的；不是的話請保存證據，並看日誌檢視器裡這個帳號被建立的時間。
column2: Confirm you or a family member added it; if not, preserve evidence and look in the log viewer for when this account was created.

column1: 你自己新增使用者、或安裝了會建立帳號的軟體都會這樣。
column2: Adding a user yourself, or installing software that creates accounts, will do this.

column1: 帳號「%s」的密碼欄寫在 /etc/passwd 裡（不是 x）
column2: The password field of account "%s" is stored in /etc/passwd (not x)

column1: 帳號「%s」在 /etc/passwd 的密碼欄是空的（沒有密碼就能登入）
column2: The password field of account "%s" in /etc/passwd is empty (it can log in without a password)

column1: 現代系統的密碼雜湊放在 /etc/shadow，passwd 的密碼欄應該是 x。不是 x 可能代表這個帳號沒有密碼或是手動寫入的。
column2: On modern systems password hashes live in /etc/shadow, and the password field in passwd should be x. If it is not x, the account may have no password or it was written by hand.

column1: 請保存證據並確認帳號來源。
column2: Preserve evidence and confirm where the account came from.

column1: 使用者「%s」被加進了特權群組「%s」
column2: User "%s" was added to the privileged group "%s"

column1: sudo、wheel、admin、docker、disk 群組的成員幾乎等於 root；入侵者常把自己的帳號加進去。
column2: Members of the sudo, wheel, admin, docker and disk groups are almost the same as root; intruders often add their own account to them.

column1: 確認是你加的；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Confirm you added it; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 你自己讓某位使用者能用 sudo 或 docker 時會出現。
column2: It appears when you let a user use sudo or docker yourself.

column1: sshd 的 AuthorizedKeysFile 指到不尋常的位置：%s
column2: sshd's AuthorizedKeysFile points to an unusual location: %s

column1: sshd 會讀這個位置的金鑰決定誰能登入；指到隱藏或暫存位置，是讓後門金鑰躲過你檢查 ~/.ssh 的手法。
column2: sshd reads keys at this location to decide who can log in; pointing it to a hidden or temporary place is a way for a backdoor key to escape your check of ~/.ssh.

column1: 確認這是你設的；不是的話請保存證據並檢查那個位置的金鑰檔。
column2: Confirm you set this; if not, preserve evidence and check the key file at that location.

column1: 集中管理金鑰的環境會把它設到 /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u。
column2: Environments with centrally managed keys set it to /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/%u.

column1: sshd 會執行這個指令來決定誰能登入；被改過的話，等於把登入權交給那個程式。
column2: sshd runs this command to decide who can log in; if it was altered, login rights are handed to that program.

column1: 確認這是你（或你的目錄服務，如 SSSD）設的。
column2: Confirm you (or your directory service, such as SSSD) set this.

column1: 使用 SSSD、FreeIPA、AWS 等單一登入的機器會設。
column2: Machines using single sign-on such as SSSD, FreeIPA or AWS set it.

column1: sshd 允許空白密碼登入
column2: sshd allows login with empty passwords

column1: 允許空白密碼，沒設密碼的帳號可以直接從網路登入。
column2: Empty passwords are allowed, so an account with no password can log in directly from the network.

column1: 改成 no，並確認每個帳號都有密碼。
column2: Change it to no, and make sure every account has a password.

column1: sshd 的 Match 區塊對特定使用者或位址放寬了設定：%s
column2: A sshd Match block loosens settings for specific users or addresses: %s

column1: Match 區塊只對符合條件的人生效，容易被忽略；攻擊者會用它替自己的來源位址開後門，同時讓全域設定看起來很安全。
column2: A Match block applies only to those who match its condition and is easy to overlook; attackers use it to open a backdoor for their own source address while the global settings look very safe.

column1: 確認這個例外是你設的；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Confirm you set this exception; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 管理者常用 Match 對內網位址允許密碼登入，或對 sftp 使用者設 ForceCommand。
column2: Administrators often use Match to allow password login from internal addresses, or to set ForceCommand for sftp users.

column1: sshd 設定最近被改過，而且允許 root 直接登入
column2: The sshd configuration was recently changed and allows root to log in directly

column1: 允許 root 從網路用密碼登入，是暴力破解的主要目標。設定檔最近才被改，要確認是你改的。
column2: Allowing root to log in over the network with a password is the main target of brute force attacks. The configuration file was only just changed; confirm you changed it.

column1: 如果不需要，改成 PermitRootLogin no（或 prohibit-password）。
column2: If it is not needed, change it to PermitRootLogin no (or prohibit-password).

column1: 雲端主機的映像常預設如此；是你自己改的就標為正常。
column2: Cloud host images often default to this; if you changed it yourself, mark it as normal.

column1: 登入時自動啟動的項目「%s」有可疑的啟動指令
column2: Autostart item "%s" at login has a suspicious start command

column1: 桌面登入時會自動執行這些項目；惡意程式常用它在你登入後啟動。
column2: These items run automatically when you log in to the desktop; malware often uses this to start after you log in.

column1: 確認這是你或你裝的軟體建立的；不認得就先保留檔案當證據，再移除。
column2: Confirm you or software you installed created this; if you do not recognize it, keep the file as evidence first, then remove it.

column1: 自己寫的啟動腳本放在隱藏資料夾時會出現。
column2: It appears when you keep a startup script you wrote in a hidden folder.

column1: modprobe 設定了「載入模組時順便執行指令」
column2: modprobe is set to "run a command when loading a module"

column1: install 規則會在某個模組被載入時以 root 身分執行指令；這是在開機時啟動後門的隱蔽方式。
column2: An install rule runs a command as root when a module is loaded; this is a stealthy way to start a backdoor at boot.

column1: 確認這條規則是你（或你裝的驅動）設的；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: Confirm you (or a driver you installed) set this rule; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 某些驅動套件（例如 NVIDIA、v4l2loopback 的設定）會設 install 規則。
column2: Some driver packages (for example the NVIDIA or v4l2loopback configuration) set install rules.

column1: 有 %d 個其他使用者的行程需要管理員權限才看得到細節
column2: %d processes of other users need administrator rights to see details

column1: 發現 %d 個「藏起來」的行程：/proc 的列舉看不到，但直接查得到
column2: Found %d "hidden" processes: not visible in the /proc listing, but found by direct lookup

column1: 正常的行程都會出現在行程清單（ps、top）裡。有行程不在清單、卻查得到，是 rootkit 隱藏自己的典型跡象。
column2: Normal processes all appear in the process list (ps, top). A process missing from the list but found by direct lookup is a classic sign of a rootkit hiding itself.

column1: 先保存證據（建立證據包）並斷開網路，再用外部乾淨的環境（開機光碟）檢查；不要在這台機器上殺掉或刪除。
column2: Preserve evidence (create an evidence package) and disconnect the network first, then check from a clean external environment (a boot disc); do not kill or delete anything on this machine.

column1: 有一些特殊情況：某些資安軟體或容器執行環境會讓 /proc 的列舉與實際不一致。如果你的電腦有裝這類軟體，請向管理員確認。
column2: There are special cases: some security software or container runtimes make the /proc listing differ from reality. If your computer has such software, confirm with your administrator.

column1: cgroup 裡有 %d 個行程，/proc 的行程清單卻看不到
column2: The cgroup has %d processes that the /proc process list does not show

column1: cgroup 是核心自己記的帳，rootkit 通常只改 /proc 的顯示、很少改 cgroup；兩邊對不起來，是行程被隱藏的跡象。
column2: The cgroup is the kernel's own bookkeeping; a rootkit usually changes only what /proc displays and rarely touches the cgroup. When the two do not match, it is a sign a process is being hidden.

column1: 先保存證據（建立證據包）並斷開網路，再用外部乾淨的環境檢查。
column2: Preserve evidence (create an evidence package) and disconnect the network first, then check from a clean external environment.

column1: 在容器或其他 PID 命名空間裡看到的 cgroup 可能包含看不見的行程；如果你是在容器裡執行這項檢查，這一項不準。
column2: A cgroup seen from inside a container or another PID namespace may contain processes you cannot see; if you run this check inside a container, this item is unreliable.

column1: 行程「%s」的名稱符合已知的%s
column2: The name of process "%s" matches a known %s

column1: 行程「%s」的參數像是挖礦程式
column2: The arguments of process "%s" look like a crypto miner

column1: 挖礦木馬會偷用你的處理器替別人賺錢，電腦變慢、風扇狂轉；它也代表有人已經能在你的電腦上執行程式。
column2: A mining trojan steals your processor to earn money for someone else, making the computer slow and the fans spin hard; it also means someone could already run programs on your computer.

column1: 先別刪除檔案；保存證據（建立證據包）後再結束行程。查看「網路連線」是否連到礦池，並檢查它是怎麼進來的（日誌檢視器看最近的登入與 sudo）。
column2: Do not delete the file yet; preserve evidence (create an evidence package) and then end the process. Look at "Network connections" to see whether it connects to a mining pool, and check how it got in (in the log viewer, look at recent logins and sudo).

column1: 如果你自己在研究挖礦或做安全測試，這是正常的；名稱比對也可能誤判剛好同名的無害程式。
column2: If you are researching mining yourself or doing security testing, this is normal; name matching can also misjudge a harmless program with the same name.

column1: 行程「%s」直接在記憶體裡執行（沒有檔案）
column2: Process "%s" runs directly from memory (no file)

column1: 行程「%s」的程式檔已被刪除，但還在執行
column2: The program file of process "%s" was deleted but it is still running

column1: 惡意程式啟動後常把自己的檔案刪掉，只留在記憶體裡，讓你在磁碟上找不到它。
column2: Malware often deletes its own file after starting and stays only in memory so you cannot find it on disk.

column1: 先別重開機：記憶體裡的行程是重要證據。保存證據包；需要時可以從 /proc/PID/exe 把檔案救出來交給資安人員。
column2: Do not reboot yet: the process in memory is important evidence. Create an evidence package; if needed you can recover the file from /proc/PID/exe and hand it to security staff.

column1: 有些軟體（AppImage、安裝程式、編譯過程）會在執行後刪除自己的暫存檔；你剛安裝或更新了東西的話可能是這個原因。
column2: Some software (AppImage, installers, builds) deletes its temporary files after running; if you just installed or updated something, that may be the reason.

column1: 行程「%s」的程式檔不見了，而且沒有新版取代它
column2: The program file of process "%s" is gone and no new version replaced it

column1: 套件更新會用新檔取代舊檔；但這個行程的檔案被刪掉後路徑上沒有檔案，可能是被移除的套件，也可能是被人刪掉。
column2: A package update replaces the old file with a new one; but after this process's file was deleted there is no file at the path, which may be a removed package or something someone deleted.

column1: 如果你最近移除了這個軟體，重新啟動就好；否則請保存證據。
column2: If you recently removed this software, just restart it; otherwise preserve evidence.

column1: 移除套件但沒有重新啟動服務時會這樣。
column2: This happens when a package is removed but the service is not restarted.

column1: 行程「%s」是從暫存資料夾執行的
column2: Process "%s" was run from a temporary folder

column1: 暫存資料夾（/tmp、/dev/shm）不是正常軟體安裝的地方，但任何人都能寫入；惡意程式幾乎都先放在這裡再執行。
column2: Temporary folders (/tmp, /dev/shm) are not where normal software is installed, yet anyone can write to them; malware almost always lands here first and then runs.

column1: 確認這是你剛啟動的程式；不認得就先保存證據，再看它連到哪裡（網路連線）。
column2: Confirm you just started this program; if you do not recognize it, preserve evidence first, then see where it connects (network connections).

column1: 編譯、測試、免安裝程式（AppImage）與開發工具常從暫存資料夾執行；是你自己啟動的就標為正常。
column2: Builds, tests, install-free programs (AppImage) and development tools often run from temporary folders; if you started it yourself, mark it as normal.

column1: 行程「%s」是從家目錄的隱藏資料夾執行的
column2: Process "%s" was run from a hidden folder in the home folder

column1: 隱藏資料夾（名稱以點開頭）不容易被看見，惡意程式有時藏在這裡；但很多合法的軟體也會把程式放在隱藏資料夾。
column2: Hidden folders (names starting with a dot) are not easily seen, and malware sometimes hides here; but many legitimate programs also keep their programs in hidden folders.

column1: 確認是你安裝的軟體；不認得就看看那個資料夾裡有什麼。
column2: Confirm it is software you installed; if you do not recognize it, look at what is in that folder.

column1: 很多工具（編輯器、遊戲平台、語言環境）會這樣；確認是你的就標為正常。
column2: Many tools (editors, game platforms, language environments) do this; mark it as normal if you are sure it is yours.

column1: 行程「%s」被強制載入了函式庫：%s
column2: Process "%s" was forced to load a library: %s

column1: LD_PRELOAD 會讓行程先載入指定的函式庫，可以攔截登入、隱藏檔案；rootkit 與偷密碼的後門常用。
column2: LD_PRELOAD makes a process load a given library first, which can intercept logins and hide files; rootkits and password-stealing backdoors commonly use it.

column1: 先保存證據；確認這個函式庫是你裝的。
column2: Preserve evidence first; confirm you installed this library.

column1: 除錯與效能工具（libfaketime、記憶體分析）會設；遊戲平台的覆蓋層也會。
column2: Debugging and profiling tools (libfaketime, memory profilers) set it; game platform overlays do too.

column1: 行程「%s」載入了暫存資料夾裡的函式庫
column2: Process "%s" loaded a library from a temporary folder

column1: 正常的軟體不會從暫存資料夾載入函式庫；這是把程式碼注入別的行程的常見跡象。
column2: Normal software does not load libraries from a temporary folder; this is a common sign of code injected into another process.

column1: 確認是你剛安裝或在編譯的東西；不認得請保存證據。
column2: Confirm it is something you just installed or are building; if you do not recognize it, preserve evidence.

column1: 開發中的程式、Java／Electron 解開的原生函式庫，會從暫存資料夾載入。
column2: Programs under development, and native libraries unpacked by Java or Electron, load from temporary folders.

column1: 行程「%s」假裝成系統程式，實際檔案在別的地方
column2: Process "%s" is pretending to be a system program, but the actual file is elsewhere

column1: 惡意程式會把自己改名成 sshd、systemd、bash 這類系統程式的名字，讓你在行程清單裡看見也不起疑。
column2: Malware renames itself to the name of a system program such as sshd, systemd or bash so you do not get suspicious when you see it in the process list.

column1: 保存證據並看它的網路連線；不要直接刪除。
column2: Preserve evidence and look at its network connections; do not delete it directly.

column1: 自己編譯的 sshd、nginx 或放在 /home 的程式可能同名；確認是你的就標為正常。
column2: A self-built sshd, nginx or a program in /home may have the same name; mark it as normal if you are sure it is yours.

column1: 行程「%s」名稱偽裝成系統核心的執行緒
column2: Process "%s" disguises its name as a kernel thread

column1: 真正的核心執行緒（名稱像 [kworker/0:1]）沒有程式檔；有程式檔卻取這種名字，是用來躲過檢查的偽裝。
column2: Real kernel threads (with names like [kworker/0:1]) have no program file; having a program file but taking such a name is a disguise used to evade checks.

column1: 保存證據並檢查它的網路連線。
column2: Preserve evidence and check its network connections.

column1: 行程「%s」的輸入輸出接在網路連線上（反向 shell 的特徵）
column2: The input and output of process "%s" are attached to a network connection (a sign of a reverse shell)

column1: 正常的 shell 接的是終端機。接在網路連線上，代表某個遠端的人正在用這個 shell 操作你的電腦（反向 shell 或綁定 shell）。
column2: A normal shell is attached to a terminal. One attached to a network connection means someone remote is using this shell to operate your computer (a reverse shell or bind shell).

column1: 立刻做：保存證據、斷開網路（「被攻擊時的處置」頁有按鈕）。先別結束行程，讓資安人員看它連到哪裡。
column2: Do this right away: preserve evidence and disconnect the network (the "What to do if under attack" page has buttons). Do not end the process yet, so security staff can see where it connects.

column1: 極少數情況：inetd／socat 刻意把 shell 接到埠（遠端維護），這種你自己會知道。
column2: Very rare: inetd or socat deliberately attaches a shell to a port (remote maintenance); you would know if you did this.

column1: 一個沒有父行程的 shell 正連到外部位址（%s）
column2: A shell with no parent process is connected to an external address (%s)

column1: shell 通常是你開的終端機或 SSH 啟動的。父行程是 init（1 號）的 shell 又連著外部網路，像是留在背景的後門。
column2: A shell is normally started from a terminal you opened or by SSH. A shell whose parent is init (PID 1) and that is connected to an external network looks like a backdoor left in the background.

column1: 保存證據並檢查這個行程是誰啟動的。
column2: Preserve evidence and check who started this process.

column1: 用 nohup 或 screen 留在背景的 SSH 工作階段有時會這樣。
column2: An SSH session kept in the background with nohup or screen sometimes looks like this.

column1: 行程「%s」長時間佔用大量處理器（平均 %.0f%%，已執行 %.0f 小時）
column2: Process "%s" has used a lot of processor for a long time (average %.0f%%, running %.0f hours)

column1: 挖礦木馬的特徵之一是一直吃滿處理器；不在已知名單裡的行程長時間滿載，值得看一眼。
column2: One sign of a mining trojan is constantly maxing out the processor; a process not on the known list at full load for a long time deserves a look.

column1: 也可以到「診斷」頁看它造成什麼影響。是你自己在跑的運算就標為正常。
column2: You can also check the "Diagnostics" page to see what effect it has. If it is a computation you are running yourself, mark it as normal.

column1: 科學運算、模擬、影片轉檔、編譯都會讓處理器長時間滿載。
column2: Scientific computing, simulation, video transcoding and compiling all keep the processor at full load for long periods.

column1: %d 個行程需要重新啟動才會用到更新後的程式
column2: %d processes need a restart to use the updated programs

column1: 套件更新替換了程式檔，但舊的行程還在用舊版（檔案顯示為已刪除）。這是正常的更新現象，不是入侵。
column2: A package update replaced the program files, but the old processes are still using the old version (the file shows as deleted). This is a normal update effect, not an intrusion.

column1: 重新啟動這些服務（或直接重開機）就會用新版；也能補上這些更新裡的安全修補。
column2: Restart these services (or simply reboot) to use the new version; it also applies the security fixes in those updates.

column1: 從暫存資料夾或隱藏路徑執行的行程「%s」正連到外部位址 %s:%d
column2: Process "%s", run from a temporary folder or hidden path, is connecting to external address %s:%d

column1: 不是正常軟體放程式的地方，卻在對外連線；惡意程式回報主人（C2）或下載後續程式時就是這樣。
column2: This is not where normal software puts its programs, yet it is connecting outward; this is what malware does when it reports to its owner (C2) or downloads further programs.

column1: 保存證據；不要馬上結束行程，先記下對方位址（可以給資安人員或查詢 IP）。必要時用「暫時斷網」。
column2: Preserve evidence; do not end the process right away, first write down the remote address (you can give it to security staff or look up the IP). Use "Cut network temporarily" if needed.

column1: 免安裝的應用程式、剛下載執行的更新程式，會從暫存資料夾連網。
column2: Install-free applications and updaters you just downloaded and ran connect to the network from temporary folders.

column1: 行程「%s」連到常見的挖礦礦池埠（%d）：%s
column2: Process "%s" is connecting to a common mining pool port (%d): %s

column1: 挖礦程式連礦池常用 3333、4444、5555、7777、14444 等埠。這是啟發式的判斷：這些埠也有別的用途。
column2: Miners often use ports such as 3333, 4444, 5555, 7777 and 14444 to reach mining pools. This is a heuristic judgment: these ports have other uses too.

column1: 看這個行程是不是你認得的程式；不是的話請保存證據。
column2: See whether this process is a program you recognize; if not, preserve evidence.

column1: 5555 是 Android 偵錯橋（adb）常用埠，4444 與 7777 常被遊戲伺服器或除錯工具使用；單看埠號很容易誤判。
column2: 5555 is a common port for the Android debug bridge (adb), and 4444 and 7777 are often used by game servers or debugging tools; the port number alone easily misleads.

column1: 行程「%s」連到常見的 Tor 埠（%d）
column2: Process "%s" is connecting to a common Tor port (%d)

column1: Tor 能隱藏連線的目的地；惡意程式有時用它躲避追蹤。但 Tor 瀏覽器等正常程式也用。
column2: Tor can hide where a connection goes; malware sometimes uses it to avoid being traced. But legitimate programs such as Tor Browser use it too.

column1: 如果你沒有在用 Tor，請確認這個行程是什麼。
column2: If you are not using Tor, confirm what this process is.

column1: 9001 也是 Hadoop 與一些服務的埠。
column2: 9001 is also a port used by Hadoop and some services.

column1: 不屬於套件的行程「%s」在高埠 %d 上等待連線
column2: Process "%s", which belongs to no package, is waiting for connections on high port %d

column1: 後門通常會開一個很高的埠等攻擊者回來連線；正常的服務大多是套件裝的，埠號也比較熟悉。
column2: A backdoor often opens a very high port and waits for the attacker to connect back; normal services are mostly installed by packages and use more familiar port numbers.

column1: 確認這個服務是你啟動的；不是的話請保存證據。也可以用防火牆擋住不需要的埠。
column2: Confirm you started this service; if not, preserve evidence. You can also block ports you do not need with the firewall.

column1: 自己開發的伺服器、遊戲伺服器、檔案分享軟體會這樣。
column2: Servers you develop, game servers and file sharing software do this.

column1: 目前有 %d 條對外連線（行程 → 目的位址）
column2: There are currently %d outbound connections (process -> destination address)

column1: 這只是清單，給你看有哪些程式正在對外連線；看到不認得的程式與位址，可以回頭查。
column2: This is only a list, so you can see which programs are connecting outward; if you see a program or address you do not recognize, look into it.

column1: 不認得的行程名稱，可以到日誌檢視器或「診斷」頁進一步查。
column2: For a process name you do not recognize, look further in the log viewer or the "Diagnostics" page.

column1: 發現強烈的入侵跡象，建議立刻處置
column2: Strong signs of intrusion found; immediate action recommended

column1: 發現 %d 項可疑跡象（高 %d、中 %d、低 %d）
輕量檢查不驗證系統檔案（比較耗磁碟）；要驗證請按「完整檢查」
column2: The light check does not verify system files (heavier on disk); click "Full check" to verify

column1: 高（含嚴重）%d、中 %d、低 %d；已標為正常 %d\n
column2: High (including critical) %d, Medium %d, Low %d; marked normal %d\n

column1: 檢查範圍：%s；%d 個行程、約 %d 個檔案；耗時 %.1f 秒（處理器 %.1f 秒）\n
column2: Check scope: %s; %d processes, about %d files; took %.1f s (processor %.1f s)\n

column1: \n（另有 %d 項已被你標為正常，沒有列出。）\n
column2: \n(Another %d items you marked as normal are not listed.)\n

column1: 入侵檢查：發現可疑跡象
日誌範圍：%s ～ %s（共 %ld 行，錯誤 %ld、警告 %ld）\n
column2: Log range: %s to %s (%ld lines, %ld errors, %ld warnings)\n

column1: 成功登入：%d 次，其中 root %d 次；來自第一次出現的來源位址：%d 次\n
column2: Successful logins: %d, of which root %d; from a source address seen for the first time: %d\n

column1: sudo／su：%d 次；帳號與群組變更：%d 次；密碼變更：%d 次；SSH 金鑰登入：%d 次\n
column2: sudo/su: %d; account and group changes: %d; password changes: %d; SSH key logins: %d\n

column1: 服務啟停：%d 次；核心錯誤與 OOM：%d 次；核心模組：%d 次；防火牆擋下：%d 次；程式當掉：%d 次；套件安裝與移除：%d 次；排程執行：%d 次；sshd 異常：%d 次\n
column2: Service start/stop: %d; kernel errors and OOM: %d; kernel modules: %d; blocked by firewall: %d; program crashes: %d; package installs and removals: %d; cron runs: %d; sshd anomalies: %d\n

column1: 說明：日誌只是主機自己記下來的事件。入侵者可能刪除或改寫日誌；日誌乾淨不代表沒有被入侵，日誌異常也不一定是入侵（失敗登入多半是網路上的自動掃描）。
column2: Note: logs are only the events the machine recorded about itself. An intruder may delete or rewrite logs; clean logs do not mean you were not compromised, and odd logs are not necessarily an intrusion (most failed logins are automated scans on the internet).
Cannot parse the --since time (for example: 1h, 24h, 7d, today, 2026-11-14 12:00)

column1: 共 %ld 行，只顯示最後 %ld 行（用 --limit 調整）\n
column2: # %ld lines in total; showing only the last %ld (adjust with --limit)\n

column1: 這個條件下沒有日誌。可能是沒有權限讀取（試試 --admin）、時間範圍太小、或這個系統沒有這些日誌檔。
column2: No logs match these filters. You may lack permission to read them (try --admin), the time range may be too small, or this system may not have these log files.

column1: （已去識別化：遮蔽使用者名稱、主機名稱與 IP 末段）
column2: (de-identified: usernames, hostnames and the last part of IPs are masked)

column1: 時間線還是空的：在日誌上按右鍵「加入時間線」，或在入侵檢查的發現上按「加入時間線」。
column2: The timeline is still empty: right-click a log line and choose "Add to timeline", or click "Add to timeline" on an intrusion check finding.

column1: 共 %d 個事件，最後一個在 %s；跨越 %ld 分鐘。
column2: %d events in total, the last at %s; spanning %ld minutes.

column1: 入侵檢查（唯讀）：系統檔案完整性、自動執行位置、行程、網路連線、核心模組、檔案系統跡象；結束碼 0＝沒有發現已知跡象、1＝有中低度跡象、2＝有高度跡象。--only miner 只看挖礦跡象，--ack 鍵／--unack 鍵 標為正常，--rebase 重建基準
column2: Intrusion check (read-only): system file integrity, autostart locations, processes, network connections, kernel modules, file system signs; exit code 0 = no known signs found, 1 = low/medium signs, 2 = high signs. --only miner looks only at cryptominer signs, --ack KEY / --unack KEY marks a finding as normal, --rebase rebuilds the baseline

column1: 日誌檢視：journald、auth.log、secure、syslog、wtmp、btmp…；--brief 安全事件摘要，--out 檔名 匯出，--anonymize 去識別化
column2: Log viewer: journald, auth.log, secure, syslog, wtmp, btmp…; --brief summarizes security events, --out FILE exports, --anonymize removes identifying details

column1: 建立證據包（.tar.gz，附 SHA-256；--verify-evidence 檔 驗證）
column2: Create an evidence package (.tar.gz, with SHA-256; --verify-evidence FILE verifies)

column1: 開視窗並直接進入某一頁（overview trend diagnose security settings intrusion logs respond）
column2: Open the window directly on a page (overview trend diagnose security settings intrusion logs respond)

column1: 這是不是挖礦程式？到「入侵檢查」看看
column2: Is this a cryptominer? See the intrusion check

column1: 嚴重 %d、高 %d、中 %d、低 %d；已標為正常 %d
column2: Critical %d, high %d, medium %d, low %d; marked as normal %d
No intrusion check has been run yet.

column1: 日誌摘要（最近 7 天的安全事件）
column2: Log summary (security events of the last 7 days)

column1: 沒有發現已知的挖礦程式跡象（只比對已知名稱、礦池埠，以及長時間佔滿處理器的行程）
column2: No signs of known cryptominers were found (only known names, mining-pool ports, and processes that keep the CPU fully loaded for a long time are checked)

column1: 這是在本機上做的檢查，無法排除高明的入侵（例如核心層的 rootkit 可以欺騙本機的檢查）。若你懷疑已被入侵，請參考「被攻擊時的處置」，並用外部乾淨的環境（開機光碟）檢查。
column2: This check runs on the local machine and cannot rule out sophisticated intrusions (for example, a kernel-level rootkit can deceive local checks). If you suspect a compromise, see "What to do when under attack" and check from an external clean environment (a boot disc).

column1: TCP 連線建立失敗（SYN 無回應）
伺服器要求帳號密碼，若重送後仍失敗，通話會被拒絕。
column2: The server requires credentials. If it still fails after resending, the call will be rejected.

column1: 檢查電話或 PBX 上設定的帳號、密碼與驗證領域（realm）是否正確。
column2: Check that the username, password and realm configured on the phone or PBX are correct.

column1: 伺服器認得你，但不允許這次呼叫（權限、來源 IP 限制或撥號規則）。
column2: The server knows who you are but does not allow this call (permissions, source IP restriction or dial plan).

column1: 檢查 PBX 的撥號權限與來源 IP 白名單。
column2: Check the PBX dialing permissions and source IP allowlist.

column1: 撥的號碼或帳號在伺服器上不存在。
column2: The number or account dialed does not exist on the server.

column1: 確認撥號規則與分機號碼，注意前置碼與國碼。
column2: Check the dial plan and extension number, paying attention to prefixes and country codes.

column1: 對方或中間設備沒有回應，通常是網路不通或被防火牆擋住。
column2: The other party or an intermediate device did not respond, usually because the network is unreachable or blocked by a firewall.

column1: 檢查 SIP 的埠（5060／5061）是否被防火牆阻擋，以及路由是否正確。
column2: Check whether the SIP ports (5060/5061) are blocked by a firewall and whether routing is correct.

column1: 對方電話沒有註冊或不在線上。
column2: The other party's phone is not registered or is offline.

column1: 確認對方分機已註冊，網路與電源正常。
column2: Make sure the other extension is registered and that its network and power are working.

column1: 對方正在通話或設定了勿擾。
column2: The other party is on a call or has Do Not Disturb enabled.

column1: 這通常不是網路問題；確認是否需要啟用多線或語音信箱。
column2: This is usually not a network problem; check whether call waiting or voicemail needs to be enabled.

column1: 兩端沒有共同支援的編碼，通話無法建立。
column2: The two ends share no supported codec, so the call cannot be set up.

column1: 在兩端電話或中繼設定共同的編碼（例如 G.711 PCMU／PCMA）。
column2: Configure a common codec on both phones or on the trunk (for example G.711 PCMU/PCMA).

column1: 伺服器過載或維護中，或中繼線路故障。
column2: The server is overloaded or under maintenance, or the trunk is faulty.

column1: 查看 PBX 與電信業者中繼的狀態，稍後再試。
column2: Check the status of the PBX and the carrier trunk, then try again later.

column1: 伺服器回應了錯誤碼，呼叫沒有建立。
column2: The server responded with an error code and the call was not established.

column1: 查看伺服器日誌，並對照回應碼的意義處理。
column2: Check the server logs and handle it according to the meaning of the response code.

column1: 沒有看到 RTP 語音封包
通話已接通但擷取不到語音：可能媒體走了別的路徑、被防火牆擋住，或擷取點看不到媒體流量。
column2: The call was connected but no audio was captured: the media may have taken a different path, been blocked by a firewall, or the capture point cannot see the media traffic.

column1: 確認擷取點在語音經過的位置（鏡像埠），並檢查防火牆與 NAT 是否允許 RTP 的 UDP 埠範圍。
column2: Make sure the capture point is where the voice passes (mirror port), and check that the firewall and NAT allow the UDP port range used by RTP.

column1: 單向語音（只有一個方向有 RTP）
column2: One-way audio (RTP in only one direction)

column1: 通話雙方有一方聽不到聲音，常見原因是 NAT 或防火牆只放行了一個方向。
column2: One party cannot hear the other. A common cause is NAT or a firewall allowing only one direction.

column1: 檢查 NAT 的 SIP ALG 與 RTP 埠轉送，或在電話上啟用 NAT 穿透（STUN／rport）；也確認擷取點能看到兩個方向。
column2: Check the SIP ALG and RTP port forwarding on the NAT, or enable NAT traversal (STUN/rport) on the phone; also make sure the capture point can see both directions.

column1: SDP 裡宣告的是私有位址，但實際的 RTP 來自另一個位址，對方可能把語音送到了錯的地方。
column2: The SDP advertises a private address, but the actual RTP comes from a different address, so the other side may be sending audio to the wrong place.

column1: 在邊界設備啟用 SIP／RTP 的 NAT 轉換（如 SBC），或讓電話使用 STUN 取得對外位址。
column2: Enable SIP/RTP NAT handling on the edge device (such as an SBC), or have the phone use STUN to learn its public address.

column1: RTP 使用的負載類型不在 SDP 協商的清單內，對方可能無法正確解碼。
column2: The RTP payload type is not in the list negotiated in the SDP, so the other side may not be able to decode it correctly.

column1: 檢查兩端的編碼清單與優先順序，讓雙方協商出相同編碼。
column2: Check the codec lists and priorities on both ends so that both sides negotiate the same codec.

column1: 遺失超過 3% 會明顯聽到斷續或雜音。
column2: Loss above 3%: choppiness or noise is clearly audible.

column1: 檢查路徑上的壅塞、Wi-Fi 訊號與介面錯誤；語音流量建議設定 QoS（DSCP EF）。
column2: Check for congestion on the path, Wi-Fi signal and interface errors; configuring QoS (DSCP EF) for voice traffic is recommended.

column1: 抖動超過 30 ms 會讓抖動緩衝撐大，增加延遲或造成斷音。
column2: Jitter above 30 ms makes the jitter buffer grow, adding delay or causing dropouts.

column1: 檢查是否有大量下載擠占頻寬，並為語音啟用 QoS。
column2: Check for heavy downloads taking up bandwidth, and enable QoS for voice.

column1: 語音已加密，本工具只統計品質，不嘗試解密。
column2: The audio is encrypted. This tool only measures quality and does not try to decrypt it.

column1: 如需分析內容請在端點上診斷，或暫時使用測試用的未加密設定。
column2: To analyze the content, diagnose on the endpoints, or temporarily use an unencrypted test setup.

column1: 「%s」不是 IP 位址（只支援位址，不做名稱解析）
column2: %s is not an IP address (only addresses are supported, no name resolution)
Port number must be between 0 and 65535: %s
VLAN ID must be between 0 and 4095
less/greater must be followed by a length
host must be followed by an address
net must be followed by a network
port must be followed by a port number
portrange must be written as start-end

column1: 過濾運算式太長（上限 500 字元）
column2: Filter expression is too long (limit 500 characters)

column1: 含有不合法的控制字元

column2: Filter expression has too many tokens

column1:
評分方法：
1. 每個發現項目依嚴重度有基本扣分：注意 3、警告 8、問題 18、嚴重 30（資訊 0），再乘以可信度（例如可信度 60% 就只扣 60%）。
2. 每一類從 100 分開始，各項以連乘方式扣分（分數 = 100 × Π(1 − 扣分/100)），所以多個問題不會扣成負數。
3. 防止「很多小事壓過一件大事」：每一類中，注意級合計最多扣 10 分、警告級合計最多扣 25 分；問題與嚴重級不設上限。
4. 總分 = 各類分數依權重平均（設備與服務 20、加密與憑證 15、無線 10、設計與分段 15、管理與預設 15、衝突與異常 15、封包行為 10）；沒有資料的類別（例如沒有無線網卡、沒有監聽封包）不計入並重新分配權重。
5. 上限：有任何「嚴重」項目，總分最高 59（F）；有任何「問題」項目，最高 79（B 以下）；有 3 個以上「警告」項目，最高 89（A 以下）。
6. 等級：A ≥ 90、B ≥ 80、C ≥ 70、D ≥ 60、F < 60。被忽略（寫了理由）的項目不計分，但報告會列出。
7. 這是被動與標準握手式的盤點，不等於滲透測試或合規稽核。
column2:
How the score works:
1. Each finding has a base deduction by severity: notice 3, warning 8, problem 18, critical 30 (info 0), multiplied by its confidence (a confidence of 60 percent deducts only 60 percent).
2. Each category starts at 100; deductions are multiplied (score = 100 × Π(1 − deduction/100)), so many problems never go below zero.
3. So that "many small things" cannot outweigh one big one: in each category notices deduct at most 10 points in total and warnings at most 25; problems and critical items are not capped.
4. Overall score = weighted average of the categories (devices & services 20, encryption & certificates 15, wireless 10, design & segmentation 15, management & defaults 15, conflicts & anomalies 15, packet behaviour 10); categories without data (for example no wireless card, no packet watching) are left out and the weights are redistributed.
5. Caps: any critical item caps the overall score at 59 (F); any problem item caps it at 79 (below A–B); three or more warnings cap it at 89 (below A).
6. Grades: A ≥ 90, B ≥ 80, C ≥ 70, D ≥ 60, F < 60. Ignored items (with a reason) are not scored but are listed in the report.
7. This is a passive, standard-handshake inventory; it is not a penetration test or a compliance audit.

column2: Network %s/24 has %d server(s)/NAS, %d computer(s) and %d IoT/camera/printer device(s). IoT devices are usually updated less and are easier to compromise; once compromised they can reach servers and computers directly. This is inferred from the mix of device types.

column1: 消費級分享器常被員工自己接進網路，可能開出第二個 DHCP 或無線網路，繞過公司的管理與防火牆。這是由 MAC 廠商與設備類型推論的。
column2: Consumer routers are often plugged in by employees themselves; they may start a second DHCP or Wi-Fi network and bypass company management and firewalls. This is inferred from the MAC vendor and device type.

column1: 確認它是誰接的、有沒有開 DHCP／無線；沒有核准就移除，或改成 AP 模式。
column2: Find out who plugged it in and whether DHCP/Wi-Fi is on; remove it if not approved, or switch it to AP mode.

column2: The only DHCP server that answered is %s, not the gateway %s. If this is the separate DHCP server you expect, fine; if it is an unknown device, a single point of failure or a replacement would affect the whole segment.

column1: 確認這台 DHCP 的身分，重要網段建議有備援。
column2: Confirm who this DHCP server is; important segments should have a backup.

column1: 開放的無線網路（沒有加密）：%s
附近的基地台 %s（%s）沒有任何加密，連上它的設備流量可被旁人讀取。這是本機無線網卡被動看到的廣播，訊號 %d%%。若是訪客網路，請確認它與內部網路隔離。

column1: 啟用 WPA2／WPA3；訪客網路用 captive portal 並隔離。
column2: Enable WPA2/WPA3; for guest networks use a captive portal and isolation.

WEP 幾分鐘內就能被破解，等於沒有加密。
column2: WEP can be cracked in minutes; it is as good as no encryption.

column1: WPA1／TKIP 已被淘汰，有已知弱點。
column2: WPA1/TKIP is obsolete and has known weaknesses.

column2: Wireless network "%s" uses different encryption settings (possible rogue access point)

column2: The same SSID was seen with %s (%s) and %s (%s), two different encryption settings. Different access points of one network may simply be configured inconsistently, or someone may have set up an access point with the same name (evil twin).

column2: LLDP/CDP announce the switch's model, software version and port names, which is useful to attackers.

column2: Turn LLDP/CDP off on ports that face users.

column2: These are protections on the switch and are not visible from an ordinary computer. This tool cannot tell whether they are enabled.

column2: Log in to the switch and check: show ip dhcp snooping, show ip arp inspection (Cisco-style commands; look up the equivalent for other brands).

column2: Confirm that this DNS is what you expect.
