column1:
使用須知

這是給網路管理者在「自己有權管理的網路」上做資產盤點與診斷的工具。它會對你選定的私有網段送出探測封包（ARP、ping、TCP 連線、mDNS／SSDP 詢問等），並讀取設備自己公開的資訊。

它不會：猜密碼、嘗試預設帳密、利用漏洞、癱瘓設備、欺騙 ARP、竄改任何設備的設定，也不會掃描公網位址。

請確認這是你有權限掃描的網路。結果只存放在你的電腦上，不會上傳。
column2:
Notice

This is a tool for network administrators to inventory and diagnose networks they are authorized to manage. It sends probes (ARP, ping, TCP connections, mDNS/SSDP queries and so on) to the private network range you choose and reads the information devices publish about themselves.

It will not: guess passwords, try default credentials, exploit vulnerabilities, knock devices over, spoof ARP or change any device's settings; it also never scans public addresses.

Make sure this is a network you are allowed to scan. Results are stored only on your computer and are never uploaded.

column2: And this IP is the default gateway, which affects the whole segment (it may also be ARP spoofing; handle it first).

column1: 常見原因：有人手動設了固定 IP，剛好和 DHCP 發出去的重複。
column2: Common cause: someone set a fixed IP by hand that happens to duplicate one handed out by DHCP.

column1: 1. 到交換器查 MAC 位址表找出兩個 MAC 各在哪個埠；2. 把其中一台改成 DHCP，或換一個沒人用的固定 IP（可用「找空 IP」）；3. 在路由器為重要設備做 DHCP 保留；4. 確認不是惡意的 ARP 欺騙（若閘道的 MAC 變了要更小心）。
column2: 1. Check the switch's MAC address table to see which port each MAC is on; 2. change one of them to DHCP or to a fixed IP nobody uses (use "Find a free IP"); 3. make DHCP reservations on the router for important devices; 4. make sure it is not malicious ARP spoofing (be extra careful if the gateway's MAC changed).

column1: 可能的 IP 衝突：%s 的 ARP 位址與 NetBIOS 回報不同
column2: Possible IP conflict: the ARP address and the NetBIOS report of %s differ

column1: ARP 回應的 MAC 是 %s，但同一個 IP 的 NetBIOS 回應說自己是 %s。可能是兩台設備搶同一個 IP，也可能是這台設備有多張網卡或經過代理 ARP（誤判可能）。
column2: The ARP reply says the MAC is %s, but the NetBIOS reply from the same IP says it is %s. Two devices may be fighting for the IP, or this device may have several network cards or sit behind proxy ARP (a false alarm is possible).

column1: 在兩個 MAC 各自找到設備（交換器 MAC 位址表），確認是否真的用同一個 IP；若是多網卡就沒問題。
column2: Find the device behind each MAC (switch MAC table) and confirm whether they really use the same IP; if it is multi-homed there is no problem.

column1: 同一個 MAC 使用了 %d 個 IP：%s
MAC %s 同時對應到 %s。常見原因：一台設備設了多個 IP（多網卡、虛擬機橋接、DHCP 租約更換還沒過期）；也可能是 MAC 被複製或偽造。
column2: MAC %s maps to %s at the same time. Common causes: one device with several IPs (multiple cards, VM bridging, an old DHCP lease not yet expired); the MAC may also have been copied or forged.

column1: 確認這台設備是否有設多個 IP；若是 DHCP 換租約，等舊租約過期即可。若 MAC 屬於一般電腦卻有很多 IP，可能是橋接器、NAT 分享器或偽造，請查它所在的交換器埠。
column2: Check whether the device has several IPs; if it is a DHCP lease change, wait for the old lease to expire. If an ordinary computer's MAC has many IPs, it may be a bridge, a NAT box or a forgery; look at the switch port it is on.

column1: %s 與 %s 使用同一個主機名稱「%s」。名稱解析（mDNS、NetBIOS、DNS）會不穩定，用名稱連線時可能連到錯的那台。
column2: %s and %s use the same host name "%s". Name resolution (mDNS, NetBIOS, DNS) becomes unreliable and connecting by name may reach the wrong machine.

column1: 把其中一台改名（作業系統的主機名稱設定）；DHCP／DNS 若自動登錄，等舊紀錄過期。
column2: Rename one of them (operating system host name setting); if DHCP/DNS registers names automatically, wait for the old record to expire.

column1: 有 %d 台 DHCP 伺服器同時回應
column2: %d DHCP servers answered at the same time

column1: 網路上不只一台 DHCP 伺服器在發放 IP。用戶端會隨機拿到其中一台給的設定（可能是錯的網段、錯的閘道或 DNS），造成部分電腦連不上網。常見原因：有人把有 DHCP 功能的分享器接錯口（用 LAN 口接到公司網路）。
column2: More than one DHCP server is handing out IPs. Clients get settings from one of them at random (possibly the wrong network, gateway or DNS) and some computers cannot get online. Common cause: someone plugged a router that has DHCP into the corporate network (through its LAN port).

column1: 1. 比對上面每台 Offer 的伺服器 IP，找出哪一台不是你預期的；2. 到交換器查它的 MAC 在哪個埠，把該設備拔掉或關閉它的 DHCP；3. 在交換器啟用 DHCP snooping，只信任連到正牌 DHCP 的埠。
column2: 1. Compare the server IP of every offer above and find the one you did not expect; 2. find its MAC on the switch, unplug the device or turn its DHCP off; 3. enable DHCP snooping on the switch and trust only the port of the real DHCP server.

column1: DHCP %s 配發的網段與本網段不一致
column2: The network handed out by DHCP %s does not match this segment

column1: 這台 DHCP 想配發 %s（遮罩 %s），但本機在 %s。拿到它的設備會被放到另一個網段，連不到本網段的設備。
column2: This DHCP wants to give out %s (mask %s), but this computer is on %s. Devices that get it are placed in another network and cannot reach devices in this one.

column1: 找出這台 DHCP 伺服器並修正它的網段設定，或把它移出本網段。
column2: Find this DHCP server and fix its network settings, or move it out of this segment.

column1: 預設閘道 %s 的 MAC 改變了
column2: The MAC of the default gateway %s changed

column1: 閘道 %s 上次是 %s，這次是 %s。可能是換了路由器、主備切換（VRRP），也可能是有人在做 ARP 欺騙想攔截流量。
column2: The gateway %s was %s last time and is %s now. The router may have been replaced, a primary/backup switchover (VRRP) may have happened, or someone may be ARP-spoofing to intercept traffic.

column1: 確認是否換過路由器；若沒有，立刻查新 MAC 在交換器的哪個埠，並在交換器啟用動態 ARP 檢測。
column2: Check whether the router was replaced; if not, immediately find the new MAC's switch port and enable dynamic ARP inspection on the switch.

column1: 同網段有兩個以上的網際網路閘道（分享器）
column2: Two or more internet gateways (routers) in the same segment

column1: 有 2 台以上的設備自稱是網際網路閘道。其中一台可能是被誤接的分享器（NAT 後面又一層網路），會造成設備拿到不同網段、互相連不到。
column2: Two or more devices claim to be an internet gateway. One may be a wrongly connected router (another NAT layer behind it), which gives devices different networks so they cannot reach each other.

column1: 確認哪一台是正牌閘道；其餘的若是無線分享器，請改成 AP 模式（關閉 DHCP／NAT，用 LAN 口接）。
column2: Find out which is the real gateway; if the others are wireless routers, switch them to AP mode (turn off DHCP/NAT and connect through a LAN port).

column2: LLDP/CDP shows that the device on this port believes it is in another VLAN; the access port may have the wrong VLAN or a trunk may be mixed in.

column1: 檢查交換器該埠的 access VLAN 設定與鄰居的 VLAN 設定是否一致。
column2: Check that the switch port's access VLAN setting matches the neighbour's VLAN setting.

column2: This IP is inside the DHCP pool but has no lease record, so it may be a fixed IP set by hand. DHCP may later give the same IP to another device, causing a future IP conflict.

column1: 把它改成範圍外的固定 IP，或在路由器為它做 DHCP 保留。
column2: Change it to a fixed IP outside the range, or make a DHCP reservation for it on the router.

column1: 定義哪些埠「允許」、哪些「不允許」。範本只是建議，不是預設強制；沒有政策時只提示常見高風險埠。評估規則：範圍越具體越優先（設備 > 標籤 > 類別 > 網段 > 全部），同層「禁止」贏過「允許」；較具體範圍的允許清單可蓋掉較不具體範圍的禁止。
column2: Define which ports are "allowed" and which are "not allowed". Templates are only suggestions, not enforced by default; without a policy only commonly risky ports are pointed out. Evaluation: the more specific the scope the higher the priority (device > label > category > network > all); at the same level "deny" beats "allow"; an allow list at a more specific scope can override a deny at a less specific scope.

column1: 有設備不停宣告自己的位址。檢查是否有設備軟體異常、雙網卡綁定錯誤，或有人在干擾 ARP 表；必要時在交換器啟用埠安全。

column1: 網段掃描行為（水平掃描）
有設備在短時間內對大量不同主機送連線請求。若不是你的資產管理或監控系統，請找出這台設備並檢查是否中毒。可把已知的掃描器加入忽略清單。
column2: A device sent connection requests to many different hosts in a short time. Unless it is your asset-management or monitoring system, find this device and check whether it is infected. Known scanners can be added to the ignore list.

column2: A device tried many different ports on one host in a short time. Find the source device; if it is your own vulnerability scanner, add it to the ignore list.

column1: 有設備對大量位址送 ping。可能是掃描器或監控系統輪詢。
column2: A device pinged many addresses. It may be a scanner or a monitoring system polling.

column1: 廣播封包量異常高，通常是網路迴圈（兩個交換器接成圈）或故障網卡。檢查交換器是否啟用 STP，並找出流量最大的埠。
column2: The broadcast volume is abnormally high, usually a network loop (two switches wired into a ring) or a faulty network card. Check that STP is enabled on the switches and find the busiest port.

column1: 多播封包量異常高。檢查 IPTV、串流設備或迴圈；交換器可啟用 IGMP snooping。
column2: The multicast volume is abnormally high. Check IPTV, streaming devices or loops; the switch can enable IGMP snooping.

column1: 單一目標收到大量連線請求。確認目標是否在被攻擊或有設備重試失控；必要時在防火牆限制單一來源的連線速率。
column2: A single target received a large number of connection requests. Check whether it is under attack or a device is retrying out of control; limit the connection rate per source on the firewall if needed.

column1: 單一目標收到大量 ping。找出來源並檢查。

column2: A single target received a large number of UDP packets. Check whether it is streaming, a backup, or an attack; find the source.

用法：pomelo-screensaver [選項]
  --preview        預覽目前選的螢幕保護程式（按任意鍵離開）

  --lock-now       立刻啟動螢幕保護程式；離開時要輸入密碼（先蓋住畫面、再鎖定，桌面不會露出來）
  --help           顯示這段說明

Usage: pomelo-screensaver [options]
  --preview        Preview the selected screensaver (press any key to exit)
  --kind NAME      Choose a kind (with --preview; see --list)
  --settings       Open the settings window
  --list           List all kinds
  --lock-now       Start the screensaver now; leaving it asks for the password (covers first, then locks, so the desktop never shows)
  --help           Show this help

column1: 先降低負載（結束不需要的運算程式）。清理機殼與風扇的灰塵、確認風扇有轉、機殼通風良好；筆電請墊高散熱。
column2: Lower the load first (stop compute jobs you do not need). Clean dust from the case and fans, check that the fans spin and the case has good airflow; raise a laptop for better cooling.

column1: 溫度偏高時顯卡可能開始降速，效能會變差。
column2: When the temperature is high the GPU may start to slow down and performance gets worse.

column1: 檢查機殼風流與風扇、清理灰塵；長時間滿載的工作可以考慮限制功耗或增加散熱。
column2: Check case airflow and fans and clean the dust; for long full-load jobs consider limiting power or adding cooling.

column1: 顯示記憶體用完時，程式會出現「out of memory」錯誤或被迫結束，也可能讓畫面卡住。
column2: When video memory runs out, programs fail with "out of memory" errors or are forced to quit, and the screen can freeze.

column1: 到「處理程序」頁找出佔用最多的程式並結束它；或到「AI 模型」頁卸載不需要的模型；改用較小的模型或較低的解析度、批次大小。
column2: Open the "Processes" page, find the program using the most and quit it; or unload models you do not need on the "AI models" page; use a smaller model or a lower resolution or batch size.

column1: 再多載入一個模型或開一個大型工作就可能放不下。
column2: Loading one more model or starting a large job may no longer fit.

column1: 留意是哪些程式與模型佔用（「處理程序」與「AI 模型」頁），不需要的先關閉。
column2: Watch which programs and models are using it (the "Processes" and "AI models" pages) and close what you do not need.

column1: 顯卡為了降溫自動降低時脈，運算與遊戲效能會明顯下降。
column2: The GPU lowers its clocks by itself to cool down, so compute and gaming performance drop noticeably.

column1: 改善散熱（清灰、風扇、通風）；如果長期如此，考慮調整風扇曲線或降低功耗上限（本工具只讀取，不會替你調整）。
column2: Improve cooling (clean dust, fans, airflow); if this keeps happening consider adjusting the fan curve or lowering the power limit (this tool only reads, it never changes anything for you).
Slowed down by the power limit

column1: 功耗達到上限，時脈被壓住；滿載運算時這是常見狀況，但若不是預期的就要留意電源與設定。
column2: Power reached its limit and the clocks are held down; this is common under full compute load, but if it is not expected, check the power supply and settings.

column1: 確認電源供應器與電源線接好；若不是刻意限制，可用 NVIDIA 官方工具檢查功耗上限設定（本工具不會更改）。
column2: Make sure the power supply and power cables are connected properly; if the limit is not deliberate, check the power limit setting with NVIDIA's official tools (this tool never changes it).

column2: Check that the fan is not blocked and the connector is not loose; if the fan is broken, stop heavy loads at once and have it repaired or replaced.

Usage: pomelo-backup [options]
  (no options)          open the backup window

  --delete-snapshot PLAN DATE --yes

column2:
Usage: pomelo-vpn [options]
  (no options)           open the GUI
  --status [--json]      show VPN status (exit code 0 OK, 1 notice, 2 problem, 3 not set up)
  --page NAME            open a page: overview, openvpn, tailscale, install
  --clients              list OpenVPN clients
  --add-client NAME --out FILE   add a client and save it as .ovpn (mode 0600, never overwrites)
  --revoke NAME          revoke a client
  --diagnose             why can't I connect: check item by item
  --help                 show this help

column1:
我可以幫你：
· 開關程式：「打開終端機」「關閉瀏覽器」「切換到 Firefox」
· 開網站、開檔案：「上 YouTube」「打開文件裡的報價單」
· 在文字檔最後加字：「在 待辦.txt 最後面加上 買牛奶」
· 建立、複製、移動檔案或丟到垃圾桶（動手前會先問你）
· 音量、亮度、深色模式、Wi-Fi、藍牙、勿擾
· 提醒、時間、天氣、電量、播放音樂
· 電腦健康檢查、空間／記憶體／IP、截圖、找檔案：「幫電腦做健康檢查」「找檔案 報價單」
· 安裝、移除套件：「安裝 vlc」「移除 vlc」（會先問你，再輸入管理員密碼）
· 關機、重新開機、登出、鎖定螢幕（關機這類會先問你）
· 簡單的計算與單位換算：「12 乘以 34」「5 公里是幾英里」
其他問題也可以直接問我。
column2:
I can help you with:
· Opening and closing apps: "open terminal", "close browser", "switch to Firefox"
· Opening websites and files: "go to YouTube", "open the quote in Documents"
· Adding text to the end of a text file: "add buy milk to the end of todo.txt"
· Creating, copying, moving files or moving them to the Trash (I ask first)
· Volume, brightness, dark mode, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb
· Reminders, time, weather, battery, playing music
· Computer health check, space / memory / IP, screenshots, finding files: "run a health check", "find file quote"
· Installing and removing packages: "install vlc", "remove vlc" (I ask first, then the administrator password is needed)
· Shut down, restart, log out, lock the screen (shutting down and the like ask first)
· Simple calculations and unit conversion: "12 times 34", "how many miles is 5 km"
You can also just ask me other questions.
No problem~ Call me if you need anything.
OK, call me if you need anything!
